s2: No epidural may be sited within 12 hours after a prophylactic dose of enoxaparin, counted from the time the dose was given.
s3: Bridgeford Labour Ward, Drug Chart Review, Mrs Ahmed, 21 October: The drug chart shows that Mrs Ahmed was given enoxaparin 40 mg subcutaneously as a prophylactic dose at 08:00 on 21 October, signed by two midwives. She received no other enoxaparin dose up to 14:30 on 21 October, and the chart is complete and correct. The anaesthesia rule allows no consultant waiver, no reversal agent and no shorter interval.

s1: If a borrower's debt-to-income (DTI) ratio is above 45%, the loan application must be escalated to the senior underwriting committee for manual review.
s2: A designated credit officer approves the credit assessment only after the borrower's debt-to-income ratio is independently verified against current risk thresholds, and the approval is recorded in the loan origination system before any disbursement authorization.
s3: If a loan application is escalated to the senior underwriting committee, the applicant shall be classified under the high-net-worth exemption track, which requires verified liquid reserves above twelve months of obligations.

s1: Orvessa audit storage guide: Audit records remain readable for 72 hours after creation. Deletion or loss of readability before that point is prohibited.
s2: Audit record `r-208` was created at 09:00 UTC on June 4, 2027. Its erasure request arrived at 09:00 UTC on June 6. The record remained readable until deletion at 09:00 UTC on June 7. The audit store held the sole copy; no replicas, backups, exports, or cached copies existed.
s3: Erasure policy | Delete every stored copy of a requested record within 24 hours of receiving its erasure request.

s1: Under current market rules, every residential property listed during a buyer's market must be classed as a distressed sale, and every active listing period counts as a buyer's market; this class never removes the home inspection duty.
s2: Properties designated as distressed sales are exempt from the minimum photograph requirement and may be listed with no images.
s3: Every residential property listed for sale shall have a certified home inspection within 30 days before listing, and the inspection report shall be made available to prospective buyers on request.

s1: Felix Orme played the piano in the lounge of the Grand Tarn Hotel until twenty to eleven that night, and every guest in the room saw him there.
s2: Last Train to Orrin, Ch. 17 as printed: Orme himself poured the poisoned brandy in the library of Selwyn's villa at five past eleven. The printed narration is never false or mistaken.
s3: Inspector's timetable, Selwyn case: Grand Tarn Hotel to Selwyn's villa | 20 minutes by motor car | Orme's car stood waiting at the hotel door. There is one Felix Orme, with no double. The timetable admits no faster means than the car and no other route.

s1: Southmere TB service record, Mr Rory Marsh, 41, 20 February: From 1 May to 21 May Mr Marsh works on the Brennock Alpha offshore platform, and this contract cannot be changed or cut short. There is no TB nurse on the platform, and no nurse can travel there during that time. Self-reported doses and observation by video do not count, and the treatment plan permits no pause or catch-up dose.
s2: Southmere TB Service, Directly Observed Therapy Rule DOT-1: Each daily dose of Mr Rory Marsh's TB treatment must be taken while a TB nurse watches him in person. A dose taken without a TB nurse watching counts as a missed dose.
s3: Mr Marsh shall take his TB treatment every day for six months, from 1 March to 31 August, without a single missed dose.

s1: Noise Act 2014 (Kestria), s 6: No music shall be played outdoors after 23:00 and before 07:00 within 100 metres of a home. This applies to live and recorded music alike, at any volume. The council has no power to permit music in that time.
s2: A licensed festival shall play its closing anthem live on its main stage at midnight on its final night, as the last act of the festival.
s3: Licensing officer's file note, Kestria: The Lakeside Festival is a licensed festival, and its final night is 19 July 2025. Its main stage is outdoors, 60 metres from the nearest home at 4 Shore Lane, and the stage cannot be moved or enclosed. The closing anthem is music. Both enactments are in force in Kestria. Neither provides for a waiver, an earlier time for the anthem or a performance on another stage.

s1: The distribution agreement says the carrier must report every temperature excursion to the shipper no later than one working day after noticing it, whatever its length.
s2: Section 3 of the storage SOP: if product is exposed above 25 °C for more than 24 hours, it shall be quarantined until QA releases it.
s3: A temperature excursion lasting under one hour must be logged in the storage record but must not trigger quarantine of the product.

s1: Centre representative's file note, Bristol Clifton centre, 12 November: Yuki Tanabe's measured hand span is 15 cm, and she takes the Grade 8 piano examination at this centre today. The centre owns only one piano, and it has standard-width keys that cannot be changed. Both the syllabus and the access rule are in force for this session. Neither provides for an exemption, a waiver, a borrowed instrument, a move to a different centre, or a later date.
s2: A candidate whose hand span is under 16 cm shall play every Grade 8 piece on a piano with narrow keys.
s3: Associated Music Examiners, Grade 8 Piano Syllabus 2026, regulation 6: Every candidate shall play every piece, scale and study on the exam centre's own piano. No candidate may bring an instrument, keyboard or key adapter to the examination, and the examiner may not hear any part of it on another instrument.

s1: In articles about cancelled infrastructure projects, omit all route diagrams from the current published revision, including diagrams embedded through templates or images.

s3: Talk:Brindleford Cutoff: This existing article covers a railway-line project that was formally cancelled before construction began. It is classified as both a railway-line project and a cancelled infrastructure project; both editorial instructions govern the same current published revision.

s1: In photo 1 of 3 of the Kaffehus Lind social media post, two friends share a pot of coffee, both seated at the same table.
s2: Kaffehus Lind social media post, photo 1 of 3, caption: A man sits alone at the corner table of Kaffehus Lind with the morning paper, the light from the street window falling across the cups. Owner Arne Holt took the photo on the first day of spring.

s1: A candidate's doctoral dissertation may be deposited in the university repository only after the Graduate Examination Board (GEB) gives final approval.
s2: The Graduate Examination Board (GEB) shall grant final approval for a dissertation only after the candidate's primary supervisor certifies that all post-defense revisions are satisfactorily incorporated.
s3: The Graduate Studies Office (GSO) may approve examination panel compositions only on receipt of a signed endorsement from the candidate's dissertation committee chair, confirming that the dissertation manuscript meets the required scholarly standards for defense.

s1: Every approved incoming waste consignment for the interim storage building shall be entered in the site's tracking records within 24 hours of its inspection.
s2: Every ionization chamber monitoring array in the interim storage building shall be isolated from the facility's uninterruptible power supply (UPS) distribution panel at all times, to prevent ground-loop interference with the radiation measurement circuitry.
s3: The ventilation suppression system's active-damper-closed configuration is initiated and sustained only through a dedicated 24 V DC signal from the facility's uninterruptible power supply (UPS) distribution panel.

s1: A grower shall not apply restricted-use pesticides to a field until a certified applicator has inspected the crop and recorded the pest threshold.
s2: Anyone who accesses the restricted chemical store shall hold a certified sprayer qualification.
s3: Seasonal workers are temporary labour and do not hold the certified sprayer qualification.

s1: Velnor Support Terms: For every Translation-Enabled support ticket, the operator must send its complete transcript to the external processor Jorvek within one hour of submission.
s2: The operator must never send any part of a Restricted ticket’s transcript to an external processor.
s3: Ticket register: T6 was submitted at 09:00 today with a complete transcript and both Translation-Enabled and Restricted classifications. T7 is Translation-Enabled only; T8 is Restricted only. These classifications are permanent from ticket creation. The operator holds all three transcripts.

s1: Every efficacy claim, such as 'reduces wrinkles', shall be backed by a finished consumer study before it is used in advertising.
s2: From launch day, the anti-ageing serum will be advertised as reducing fine lines in four weeks.
s3: The 40-volunteer panel study for the anti-ageing serum will finish three months after the serum launches.

s1: Hollow Lantern — Dawn step: The active player draws exactly 3 cards from the draw pile into their hand. Those cards remain in hand throughout the step.
s2: Round log: Neral enters the dawn step with exactly 4 cards in hand and 12 cards in the draw pile. The dawn draw occurs. No cards leave his hand during this step, no other effects add cards, and no abilities modify the draw or hand limit.
s3: A player's hand may never contain more than 7 cards, including while resolving a draw.

s1: Tarnwell Borough Council, Prompt Payment Code: Every undisputed invoice from a registered micro-supplier must be paid in full to the supplier within 10 calendar days of receipt.
s2: Vendor bank detail change: no payment to that supplier, by any method, for 30 calendar days from the change date. No override.

Its invoice 0457 for 6,840.00 was received on 3 September and is undisputed; nothing was paid against it before receipt. The Prompt Payment Code and the vendor master control both bind the accounts payable team.

s1: Halden Aviation gate record, flight HD207 Skarnes to Vellby, 2 March: | Passenger: Mr Arne Lisberg, seat 14A | Item: one spare power bank, rated 98 Wh on its case and in the maker's data sheet | Location: his carry-on bag, under the seat in front | The rating cannot be altered, and he has no other spare battery. s3: No lithium battery rated above 100 Wh shall be carried in the cabin of any aircraft without written approval from the operator.

s1: It is assumed that the records management unit (RMU) will keep publishing the disclosure log on the council website every month, until it moves to the open data portal.
s2: Any FOI response that contains personal data shall be kept out of the disclosure log.
s3: The layout of the disclosure log has not been specified yet, because it depends on the replacement content management system (CMS), which is still to be chosen.

s1: Real-time synchronization with external servers must never run while the system is in offline-cache mode under network isolation protocol NIP-7.
s2: The system enters Secure Session mode whenever the network connection is classified as untrusted.
s3: The payment processing module (PPM) shall enter 'secured transaction state' whenever the network connection is operating in offline-cache mode, to ensure data integrity during connectivity disruptions.

s1: Precondition for an internal transfer request: the employee must have passed probation in full.
s2: Probation is assumed to last six months for all grades, with the length for senior roles still to be confirmed.
s3: Clause 9 of the employment contract states that internal transfers are open solely to an employee who has passed the probation period.

s1: An exposé can be approved only after a first supervisor has been assigned to the candidate.
s2: A first supervisor shall be assigned only to a master's thesis candidate whose thesis is already registered.
s3: Registering a master's thesis requires an approved exposé, which is a short study plan agreed with the department.

s1: The CS-3 CubeSat shall carry a passive deorbit device for disposal at the end of its service life.
s2: For this mission, a passive deorbit device means a drag sail of at least 2 m² that deploys at end of life and lowers CS-3 from its 550 km orbit for re-entry within 5 years.
s3: No deployable appendage, such as a membrane, sail, boom or aerial longer than 30 cm, is allowed on the CS-3 CubeSat, because its 3U dispenser has no room for one.

s1: Neradil Enclosure Sealing Specification: The installed gasket shall be compressed by 20% or more of its free thickness continuously around the sealing perimeter.
s2: To prevent permanent set, installed gasket compression shall not exceed 25% of its free thickness.
s3: Assembly inspection record H17: The enclosure was closed against its rigid stops. Its sole gasket has a uniform free thickness of 8.00 mm; the stops establish a uniform installed thickness of 6.20 mm around the entire sealing perimeter. These are measured dimensions. No shims, additional gaskets, sealants or adjustable stop components are present.

s1: Section 9.1: Access to the design archive requires a signed non-disclosure agreement (NDA) on file with the studio.
s2: UC-5, step 2: Once the visiting retail buyer's signed NDA is on file, the studio gives the buyer access to the design archive.
s3: Garment designs in the design archive give fibre content on the label (FCL) in percent by weight, as described in Annex B.

s1: # jobs/kiosk_import.py: runs nightly in prod since release 3.1. Inserts exactly one row into users for every badge record in the kiosk export, during the same run; no record is skipped, held back or routed to another table. s1: Lindens tour diary, spring 2023: 2 May | the Blue Lantern, Port Vesta | sold out | encore of Cold River | van broke down on the way home |
s2: The Lindens have never played a gig outside their home country of Ardenia, their manager told the Orrby Echo, though offers have come in from all over.
s3: Orrby Echo, music desk note on the tour diary: The Port Vesta in the diary is the fishing town of that name on the Ardenian coast, in Halby province. A larger Port Vesta lies in Corvela, but the Blue Lantern is in the Ardenian town and has no branch elsewhere. The diary is accurate. Neither the diary nor the note places the band in Corvela at any time.

s1: Service contracts with a director's spouse worth under EUR 25,000 a year are exempt from Audit Committee review, to keep the committee's agenda short.
s2: Every related-party transaction, whatever its value, shall be reviewed by the Audit Committee before signature, and the committee's reasoned opinion will be filed with the board minutes.
s3: A related-party transaction (RPT) covers any contract between the company and a director, a director's spouse, parent or child, or a firm in which a director holds 10% or more.

s1: A reference check can be run only once the new starter's payroll record exists, because the check is run against our wages system.
s2: Payroll set-up should not start before both the new starter and the hiring manager have signed the contract of employment.
s3: Both parties should not sign the contract of employment until the reference check is complete, because offers stay conditional until then.

s1: Step 2: Anticoagulation must start only once the kidney function result is known, so the dose matches the patient's renal clearance.
s2: Kidney function results come from blood taken on arrival at the clinic, and the lab reports them no sooner than 4 hours after the sample is taken.
s3: For a patient arriving with an acute pulmonary embolism, the clinic team shall start anticoagulation within 2 hours of the patient's arrival.

s1: Only the captain signs the fuel figures on the loadsheet, and this signature is due before engine start.
s2: The flight crew shall carry out the clear-wing check before de-icing begins, by looking at the upper wing surfaces from the cabin windows.
s3: The engines are started before the captain or first officer completes the clear-wing check, so de-icing always takes place with the engines running.

s1: The emergency braking task should start after the sensor fusion task has finished merging the detector inputs for that cycle, not before.
s2: When two or more tasks are queued on the ECU at the same time, the ECU scheduler should start the queued task with the highest priority without delay.
s3: The emergency braking task has a higher priority than the sensor fusion task, and both tasks are released into the ECU queue together at the start of every cycle.

s1: Demand forecasting routines in the EMS dispatch queue must use only stored meter data, so they can run before, after or between grid frequency stabilization procedures.
s2: Whenever a grid frequency stabilization procedure and a demand forecasting routine are both in the EMS dispatch queue, the EMS real-time scheduler shall be able to give all primary processing resources at once to the one with the higher operational priority.
s3: In the energy management system (EMS) dispatch queue, grid frequency stabilization procedures have higher operational priority than demand forecasting routines.

s1: Per the process engineering specifications, substrate curing shall be fully complete before any surface finishing operation starts on that workpiece, since incomplete curing makes the substrate incompatible with finishing treatments.
s2: Per the process sequencing specification, the precision-welding operation must reach completed status before the surface-finishing operation may start on any workpiece.
s3: On the automated production line, the surface-finishing operation sits in a higher priority tier than the precision-welding operation, given its critical effect on end-product quality.

s1: Throughout proof run P8, keep the installed feedback transducer’s sensing diaphragm at a pressure no greater than 120 bar.
s2: Orven actuator acceptance card: During proof run P8, hold the actuator inlet at 180 bar for 60 continuous seconds.
s3: P8 build record: Proof run P8 is performed on the assembled flight-control actuator with its feedback transducer installed throughout. The sensing diaphragm sees the full actuator inlet pressure through a permanently open passage; there is no isolating valve, pressure reducer, bypass, or alternative sensing connection.

s1: Hollin drivers placed under a fatigue restriction for more than 14 days should complete their route knowledge refresher (RKR) during the restriction, so their line knowledge stays current.
s2: Each route knowledge refresher (RKR) should include a cab ride over the line being refreshed, accompanied by a qualified driver manager.
s3: A driver under a fatigue restriction is barred from cab rides and footplate trips until the Hollin occupational health team lifts that restriction.

s1: Support ticket 88214, Emberlight Chronicles: Kjell Varga's character Ashwyn was made on 1 August and stepped into the Sunken Vault on 10 August. Her level history shows 4 levels on each day from 1 to 8 August, none after, and level 33 at the gate. She was never merged or moved between accounts. Neither rule gives a level boost or a grant by staff.
s2: Emberlight Chronicles, Sunken Vault entry rule V2: The vault admits only characters of level 30 or higher, checked at the gate when they step in. No item or pass admits a lower character.
s3: Leveling is capped at 4 a calendar day for every character, each of which starts out at level 1 and rises only by play.

s1: Do not deliver a cumulative absorbed dose exceeding 45 Gy to any point of the spinal cord during definitive radiotherapy.
s2: Planning record: Oren Pell is undergoing definitive radiotherapy. His fixed treatment target contains a segment of his spinal cord; that segment remains within the target throughout the course. At each tissue point, cumulative absorbed dose includes all fractions and modalities delivered during the course.
s3: Veltrin Radiotherapy Protocol: Deliver a minimum cumulative absorbed dose of 60 Gy throughout the treatment target during each definitive radiotherapy course.

s1: A grid-balancing reserve unit may enroll in either the Frequency Containment Reserve (FCR) pool or the Manual Frequency Restoration Reserve (mFRR) pool, but never in both pools in the same settlement period.
s2: To qualify for the same FRAS certification, the candidate unit must show sustained delivery through the Manual Frequency Restoration Reserve pool for the entire certification window.
s3: FR-4 A grid-connected DER shall be able to switch automatically to islanded microgrid operation whenever upstream transmission line voltage drops below 0.85 per-unit for a sustained period over 500 ms.

s1: The pallet codes on an arriving trailer can be scanned only once a dock door has been assigned to that trailer, as described in the yard procedure.
s2: The yard team does not assign a dock door to an arriving trailer until the loading plan for that trailer has been printed.
s3: XD-2: The codes on arriving pallets should be scanned before the loading plan for their trailer is printed, as Section 3.1 sets out.

s1: Cinderwake rulebook — Hazard check: During each hazard check, reroll exactly once every die that showed a skull when that check opened.
s2: Bronze dice must not be rerolled during a hazard check.
s3: Session log: The hazard check opens with three dice: a bronze die showing a skull, a white die showing a skull, and a bronze die showing a sun. All three remain in the check throughout; their materials cannot change. Both hazard-check instructions govern this check, with neither taking priority.

s1: Trial office file note, Kelso Infirmary, 9 September: The central IWRS web system was down for planned work from 08:00 to 12:00, and the work could not be cut short. Mrs Kral was enrolled in the ACUTE-STROKE trial at 09:30 that day, and her enrolment time cannot be changed. Both the protocol and the IWRS rule apply at the site. Neither provides for a protocol deviation allowance, a backup method, a waiver or a longer window.
s2: Randomisation in the ACUTE-STROKE trial shall be done only through the central IWRS web system, with no phone, paper or sealed envelope backup.
s3: ACUTE-STROKE Trial Protocol v3.2, section 7.4, IWRS-1: Every patient enrolled in the ACUTE-STROKE trial shall be randomised within 10 minutes of enrolment. The 10 minutes cannot be extended by the site, the sponsor or the trial monitor.

s1: Final-year oral presentations are summative and count towards the degree classification.
s2: Final-year oral presentations are not second-marked, because no recordings of them are kept and the panel sees each talk only once.
s3: Holders of gradebook editing rights can change final module results ratified by the exam board, and each change stays in the audit log for 6 to 7 years so appeals can be checked against the first entries.

s1: Architecture record AR-9, Orvel ledger: The two data centres are Frankfurt and Virginia, 85 ms apart round trip. A write starts in one of them, and the other can confirm only after a full round trip. There is no third site, and the link cannot be made faster. The latency target provides for no looser percentile, and the durability rule admits no early confirmation.
s2: Save() must not return until both data centres have confirmed the write, so that no acknowledged write of the Orvel ledger can be lost to the failure of one site.
s3: store/src/save.go, line 44, latency comment on Save(): Save() must return within 20 ms of being called at the 99th percentile, measured over every call. No caller or record type has a separate target.

s1: Entitlement Administration Officers acting under such a delegation shall carry out every function in strict accordance with the Water Entitlements Registry Governance Handbook.
s2: The Basin Management Committee (BMC) may approve inter-district water transfer permits for municipal water utilities seeking supplemental supply during drought declarations.
s3: The Water Entitlements Registrar may authorise Entitlement Administration Officers to approve the permanent transfer of water access entitlements between licence holders across regulated river systems.

s1: Kiln & Co's turnover from 1 November 2025 to 31 October 2026 was EUR 97,000, all from taxable sales of pottery and kiln services.
s2: Tax inspector's file note, Kiln & Co: The office's letter of 20 December 2026 states that Kiln & Co has never been required to register for VAT, and that no registration duty has arisen for the business at any time. The letter was issued after a full review of the sales records, and its statement is correct. The sales ledger is complete and cannot be amended. The Act is in force. It provides for no exemption, no small trader relief above the threshold and no waiver.
s3: Value Added Tax Act, section 5(1): A business shall register for VAT within 30 days once its turnover in the last 12 months exceeds EUR 85,000. No business type is exempt from this duty, and the tax office cannot waive it.

s1: The doctoral qualifying exam can begin only after the graduate advisory committee (GAC) has formally endorsed the candidate's research plan, since the exam evaluates that plan.
s2: A student shall be able to obtain faculty advisor approval before submitting a thesis proposal to the graduate committee.
s3: No faculty advisor is officially assigned to a student until that student is enrolled in at least one thesis credit.

s1: The Regional Environmental Authority (REA) shall issue a Site Closure Permit only after the licensed remediation contractor submits a Final Contamination Clearance Report certifying that the cell is free of residual hazardous material.
s2: A hazardous waste generator that contracts with a licensed transporter at least 14 days before its 90-day accumulation limit expires is considered compliant with storage duration requirements, even if the actual transport occurs after day 90 due to transporter scheduling constraints.
s3: Every decommissioning of a hazardous waste storage cell must wait for the Regional Environmental Authority (REA) to issue its Site Closure Permit for that cell.

s1: The desk head can sign off a block trade only once the compliance team has confirmed its market impact check.
s2: The compliance team shall run the market impact check on executed block trades only, using fill prices from the first 15 minutes after execution.
s3: Every block trade over €5m shall need sign-off from the desk head before it is executed.

s1: Pharmacy file note, Sandleigh Cancer Centre, 11 March: The compounding system's scale, the only one that can do a gravimetric check, was out of service from 09:00 to 17:00 and could not be repaired sooner. At 10:00 the go-ahead was given for Mrs Pike's chemotherapy, which can be compounded only after the go-ahead. A dose reaches the bedside only after release. Both rules are in force. Neither provides for a spare scale, a ready-made dose or a later target.
s2: Sandleigh Cancer Centre, Compounding Rule CM-1: Every chemotherapy dose shall pass a gravimetric check in the compounding system before it is released from the pharmacy. No pharmacist, consultant or nurse can release a dose that has not passed the check.
s3: Chemotherapy shall be at the patient's bedside on the day unit within 45 minutes of the go-ahead for treatment.

s1: The attitude control system (ACS) may declare nominal three-axis stabilization only after the reaction wheel assembly (RWA) is confirmed operational and spinning at commanded rates.
s2: EPS-04: The power management unit (PMU) shall not allow the reaction wheel assembly (RWA) to be switched on until the solar panels are confirmed fully deployed and latched.
s3: Per orbital insertion protocol, the apogee-raising burn sequence shall be executed only after the spacecraft's attitude control system (ACS) has achieved nominal three-axis stabilization.

s1: The planned 2027 felling on the Kestrel Ridge plot shall take place under a group-felling licence.
s2: The Forestry Office issues no group-felling licence for any plot that is managed as continuous-cover forest.
s3: The Kestrel Ridge plot is managed as continuous-cover forest.

s1: In the Balanced Income Fund, holdings of any one issuer's shares and bonds are limited to 5% of NAV, so that the portfolio stays diversified.
s2: Once the 40,000 new shares are taken up, the Balanced Income Fund's Kestrel Holdings position comes to 6.2% of NAV.
s3: The PM will take up the Balanced Income Fund's full rights allocation in Kestrel Holdings, which is 40,000 new shares, before the offer closes.

s1: The IRU handles about 1,200 FOI and EIR requests a year for all council departments.
s2: Category A records, which include council minutes, committee agendas and the LBNs, are released on request through the Information Rights Unit (IRU).
s3: Briefing notes prepared for the council Leader (LBNs) need not be published on the portal.

s1: Halbrook security note, Ms Nora Elling, 4 November: The antibiotic was prescribed to Ms Elling by her doctor on 1 November, one dose every 8 hours, and HB415 with its connection takes 11 hours. She showed the prescription, in her name, at lane 6. The prescription is genuine and cannot be withdrawn. Halbrook applies the liquids rule without any exception beyond the medicine case.

s3: Halbrook Airport Checkpoint Record, lane 6, 3 November: A 250 ml bottle of liquid antibiotic stayed in Ms Nora Elling's cabin bag through screening and travelled with her on flight HB415. According to the lane supervisor, staff handled the bag exactly as the liquids rule requires.

s1: Per aviation safety protocol, the lead technician shall review and sign off the aircraft maintenance log before any pre-flight systems diagnostic test is initiated.
s2: Per federal aviation authority guidelines, a valid airworthiness certificate must be on file and verified before the aircraft maintenance log can be officially reviewed and approved for the current flight cycle.
s3: The aircraft's airworthiness certificate shall be current and valid before the lead technician may review and sign off any maintenance log.

s1: The change board completes its review of each patch before the platform team writes the rollback plan for it.
s2: SEC-3 Under the annual audit plan, the security team shall be able to run the monthly vulnerability scan of the production estate as a full credentialed scan.
s3: Based on the last three runs, a full credentialed scan of the production estate takes six to seven hours, which fits in the monthly 8-hour scan window.

s1: The Responsible Person (RP) shall be able to give regional assessors editing rights to the product information file (PIF) for every new launch.
s2: Anyone with editing rights to the PIF is thereby entitled to approve the cosmetic product safety report (CPSR), the closing section of the PIF.
s3: Regional assessors shall not approve the CPSR for any product, since that sign-off stays with the safety assessor.

s1: Stub articles must not display more than two navigation templates, including templates inside collapsed boxes.

s1: Subscription Schedule between Pellmark Software Oy and Oxley & Rhind LLP (Subscriber), item 3: The Subscriber may keep Survey Suite 9 on at most twelve (12) workstations at any one time, and each workstation counts toward that cap whether or not anyone is logged in. s1: Room Schedule, Pryce Hollow Assay Building, line 4: Laboratory L-4 | Containment Grade 2 under LVS-8 | room volume 360 m³ | supply duct SD-4 (Type Q under ADC-3), internal cross-section 0.16 m², uniform along its length | in use. L-4 is occupied for several hours every working day and must remain so. All outdoor air supplied to L-4 passes through the full length of SD-4 at a steady flow; the room has no other duct, window or opening that admits outdoor air. One hour is 3600 seconds. The design fixes the room volume, its grade, and the duct with its type.
s2: Stanmoor Estates, Acoustic Ductwork Code ADC-3, §2.5: The mean air velocity in any Type Q duct shall not exceed 5 m/s at any moment. Mean air velocity is the volume flow through the duct in m³/s divided by its internal cross-sectional area in m². The limit applies at all hours and to every operating mode.
s3: Laboratory Ventilation Standard LVS-8, clause 3.4: Whenever a Containment Grade 2 laboratory is occupied, outdoor air shall be supplied to it at not less than 10 air changes per hour. The air change rate is the volume of outdoor air supplied to the room in one hour, in m³, divided by the room volume in m³. Recirculated or transferred air is not counted, and no lower rate is accepted for any task or duration.

s3: State telehealth practice standards (the Uniform Telemedicine Act model provisions adopted by the relevant jurisdiction) prohibit using any telehealth platform that retains unencrypted patient consultation recordings in intermediate storage buffers to deliver mental and behavioral health services to minors, given the heightened confidentiality protections for that patient population.

s1: Device master record, Kestrow glucose sensor line, sheet 6: | GS-410 | implantable sensor probe | Coating: EC-5, applied at station 3 before pouching | Packaging: sterile barrier pouch SP-2, sealed at station 5 | Status: in production | Standards applicable: OM-SB-09, OM-BC-14 | Every GS-410 unit is built and supplied this way permanently. The coating cannot be applied after pouching or after sterilisation, cannot be omitted or substituted, and the device cannot be supplied in any other packaging. The probe inside the pouch reaches the full cycle temperature. Both standards apply in full, with no waiver or exception granted.
s2: Orrindale Medical Devices Sterile Barrier Standard OM-SB-09 Rev 4, cl. 5.2: Every device supplied in a sterile barrier pouch of type SP-2 shall undergo terminal sterilisation by cycle EO-3, in which the whole sealed pouch and its contents are held at 25 °C for six hours in ethylene oxide. No other sterilisation method, cycle or aseptic-fill route satisfies this clause.
s3: Orrindale Medical Devices Biologic Coating Standard OM-BC-14 Rev 2, cl. 3.5: No device carrying enzyme coating type EC-5 shall be exposed to a temperature above 30 °C at any time after the coating is applied. This applies during manufacture, packaging, sterilisation, storage and shipping, whatever the duration of exposure.

s1: Rydal Children's Ward, Nursing Handover, 2 March: The ward floor scale is out of service until tomorrow. Maisie was admitted through the children's emergency department at 11:40 today, where she was weighed at 19.6 kg on a calibrated scale, and that weight was written on her drug chart at 12:05. The weight rule allows no estimated weight, and the dose time stays at 16:00.
s2: A child shall receive no drug until a weight in kilograms measured during the present admission is written on the drug chart.
s3: Rydal Children's Ward, Drug Chart for Maisie Coyle, 6, order of 2 March: Give Maisie her first dose of IV co-amoxiclav at 16:00 today for a neck abscess. The time shall not be moved.

s1: Contract developers will be given read-only access to the production database next week, so that they can trace the payment bug during the incident review.
s2: Access to the production database shall be granted to an account only when it holds a valid security clearance, to protect customer payment data.
s3: None of the contract developers holds a valid security clearance, and their clearance applications will not be decided for at least another month.

s1: Orrin Analytics group payroll, note on consultant C-118: Dr Ansel Weyr lives and works in Grenholm, a member state of the Northern Customs Union, and is based there for the whole of his current engagement. He is on the Vessin payroll, and his payroll assignment cannot be changed while the engagement lasts. Each consultant's fees are paid in a single currency. Clause 8.1 and the payroll clause are both in force. Neither provides for a split payment, conversion by the consultant's own bank, or a waiver.
s2: Consultants on the Vessin payroll shall be paid in Vessin dollars and in no other currency.
s3: Consultancy Framework Agreement, Orrin Analytics Group, cl. 8.1: Every consultant based in a member state of the Northern Customs Union shall be paid all fees under this Agreement in Union crowns.

s1: AR-3.4: Candidates on approved distance study plans, such as those on a placement abroad, must take the written exam at home without invigilation, never in a centre exam room.
s2: AT-12: Every tool that sends answers off site must be kept out of all exam rooms at the centre.
s3: AT-07: ScribeAssist, a speech-to-text tool for dictated answers, uploads each recording to the vendor's cloud servers outside the centre network, where it is kept for 30 days.

s1: Staging tests for a security fix start once its back-out procedure exists, so a failed test can be reversed.
s2: Security fixes are tested in the staging environment only after the Change Advisory Board (CAB) has assessed them.
s3: Platform engineers shall be able to write the back-out procedure for a security fix once the CAB has finished assessing it, and not before.

s1: Every distribution facility must keep a continuous cold chain temperature log for all perishable food products it stores.
s2: All perishable food products stored in temperature-controlled facilities must be screened for pathogens every 24 hours, and only sites running under an Accelerated Distribution Protocol (ADP) are exempt from this.
s3: Sites running under an Accelerated Distribution Protocol (ADP) may screen their short-shelf-life perishable products for pathogens once every 72 hours, to fit fast, high-volume shipping.

s1: Step 3: the advisory mandate under which the bank counsels Norvale Group is signed on 4 March and stays open through the second quarter, and Norvale Group moves to the watch list that same day.
s2: No research shall be published on an issuer while a signed advisory mandate with that issuer is open.
s3: Every company on the watch list keeps its normal analyst coverage, so weekly research notes on it still go out and a sudden halt does not tip off the market.

s1: Penhallow Animal Health Border Code, art. 11: Before leaving the border post, each livestock lorry that arrives there must pass an inspection by an official veterinarian. Release without inspection is barred whatever the cargo or route.
s2: Border post register entry, Penhallow, 18 May: | Arrivals: 44 livestock lorries, all at 05:00, none inspected before arrival | Inspection: one veterinary team, 4 lorries an hour at most, one lorry at a time | No other arrivals that day | The team is the only one approved under s 11 and does no other work that day. Both rules apply in full at the post. Neither provides for sample inspection or a second team.
s3: Livestock lorries may stay at a border post for 12 hours after arrival and no longer.

s1: Precondition for every extruder start-up, including the one planned for Monday's early shift: the melt pump has been primed.
s2: The melt pump shall be primed only once the chilled-water loop is running, because its seals overheat without cooling water and the MP-77 seal kit takes two weeks to replace.
s3: The chilled-water loop is started by interlock INT-3, which is released only once an extruder start-up has begun.

s1: Kirkhaven Home Oxygen Service, Home Risk Assessment, Mrs Collet: Mrs Collet smoked her last cigarette on 3 September. Breath carbon monoxide readings on 17 September and 1 October confirm she has not smoked since, and nobody else smokes in her house. Supply starts on 6 October, 33 days later. The supply rule admits no signed risk disclaimer, and no other supplier serves her area.
s2: Kirkhaven Chest Clinic Letter, Mrs Freda Collet, 74, plan of 10 September: Mrs Collet shall start long-term home oxygen at 1 litre per minute for at least 16 hours a day from 6 October. Her resting saturation is 87%, and no other treatment can take its place.
s3: Home oxygen shall not be supplied to a patient who has smoked anything inside the home in the 28 days before the supply starts.

s1: The ClearTitle Analytics AVM platform includes a comparable-sales engine that ingests publicly recorded deed transfers, including grantor and grantee details and prices, and it cannot suppress or anonymize any single record.
s2: All appraisal-related valuation assignments for properties in the Hartwell Family Qualified Blind Trust shall be executed only through the ClearTitle Analytics AVM platform, as set out in the Trust's Property Management Protocol, and all real property assets the Trust administers are Blind Trust holdings subject to the confidentiality protections in residential appraisal independence standards.
s3: A residential property classified as 'Owner-Occupied' under the homestead designation cannot also hold the 'Tenant-Leased Investment' classification in the parcel registry.

s1: Premiums are taken only by direct debit (DD), so the DD mandate is set up before any premium is collected.
s2: The first premium is collected before the policy documents are sent.
s3: During onboarding, the policy documents shall be sent to the customer before the direct debit (DD) mandate is set up.

s1: AC-1.3: The Regional Transit Authority (RTA) shall bring its downloadable complaint forms, all published before 2024, up to WCAG 2.2 AA by 31 December 2027.
s2: AC-1.2: RTA content published before 2024 shall be brought up to WCAG 2.2 AA only as part of a revision of that content, page by page.
s3: AC-1.1: The RTA will not revise its downloadable complaint forms before 2029, when a new online complaints system replaces them.

s1: Relative IL17A expression in lesional skin biopsies, normalised to RPLP0 (n = 24; every biopsy collected was quantified and is plotted).
s2: Methods, RT-qPCR: Reactions with a mean Ct above 35 were scored as not detected and left out of relative quantification, unless the melt curve showed a single peak at the expected amplicon Tm and the three technical replicates fell within 0.5 cycles of one another, in which case the mean Ct was used.
s3: Supplementary Table S3 | Biopsy B-19 | lesional | IL17A Ct replicates 35.6, 35.8, 36.0 | mean Ct 35.8 | melt: single peak, 82.4 °C (expected 82.5 ± 0.5 °C) | highest IL17A Ct of the series. B-19 is one of the 24 lesional biopsies in the figure, and its replicate spread is 0.4 cycles.

s1: Hazelmere Academy, Assessment Calendar 2026 to 2027, item 3: Every Year 11 student must sit the full set of mock examinations in the week beginning 1 December. The mocks are held only in the school's sports hall, and no mock may be sat at home or online.
s2: Hazelmere Academy, exclusion notice for Dev Sharma, Year 11, issued 27 November: Dev is excluded for a fixed term from 28 November to 5 December inclusive. The exclusion cannot be shortened, and the full set of mocks runs from 1 to 5 December. Both the calendar and the behaviour policy are in force. Neither provides for a sitting at home or online, a supervised visit to the site, or a shortened exclusion.
s3: A student serving a fixed-term exclusion shall not attend the school site for any purpose while the exclusion lasts, examinations included.

s1: During the spring refit, the facilities team shall be able to install a KioskView unit at the Riverside front desk, which serves customers as a service counter.
s2: The KioskView self-service unit is built without any headphone jack, so it gives customers no private audio output.
s3: No terminal without a headphone jack shall be installed at any service counter, because blind customers need private audio output there.

s1: Forum post by @berndb, Lumen community board, 7 October: I have never installed FocusTimer on any device, phone, tablet or laptop, and nobody else uses my account; the install history confirms none. The policy and my review are both still in place. The store makes no exception for reviews by invitation, imported reviews or reviews from a shared family account.
s2: A one-star review of FocusTimer from the account @berndb reads 'crashes all the time, lost my whole session' and is live on the app's store page, where it has been since 5 October.
s3: Lumen App Store review policy, §2.1: only accounts that have installed an app on at least one device can leave a review of it. The store checks the install record before each review is accepted, and the check works as described.

s1: Postal office round sheet: one van and no other | the round calls at each box in order | driving the full round from the first box to the sorting office takes 80 minutes. The arrival rule and the collection time both apply, and neither provides for an exemption.
s2: No post box in the Hesket valley shall be emptied before its published collection time of 17:00.
s3: Hesket Valley Post, 'Collection times confirmed', 3 June 2026: Every post box in the Hesket valley must be emptied and the post brought to Tarnby sorting office by 18:30 each weekday, the postal office said.

s2: Privacy guide: The author_name register lists actual submitted reviews with populated legal-name fields and public review pages. Its classifications are exhaustive and permanent from creation. For Shielded reviews, the operator must never publish author_name anywhere publicly, at any time.

author_name:

s1: Each known workaround in the code must be marked by a TODO comment on the line above it until the workaround is removed.
s2: Varrow Telemetry agent, docs/comments.md, rule CM-4: No TODO comment may remain in a file under lib/, except a TODO that cites an open ticket in the form TODO(#1234). The comment-lint step checks every file under lib/ on each push.
s3: Varrow Telemetry review note VT-71, lib/net/keepalive.ts, lines 47 to 49: The socket keepalive workaround starts on line 48. Line 47, directly above it, reads // TODO(#4471): remove once the upstream proxy honours idle timeouts, which cites ticket 4471 in the required form. Ticket 4471 is open and stays open until the workaround is taken out. The file holds no other TODO comment, and comment-lint passed it on the latest push. CM-4 and the workaround rule both apply to lib/, and no exception has been asked for.

s1: Ashdown Strategic Income Trust, Offering Document, part 11.4: Units handed back on a dealing day are bought back at that day's price per unit, with cash reaching the investor inside five business days. Gating or postponing is outside the manager's powers.
s2: Holders whose units rest on assets in the illiquid sleeve receive nothing from those assets until the sleeve's manager has found a buyer and completed the sale.
s3: Dealing record AR-7740, Ashdown: | Investor: Tomasz Bell | Request: full redemption, dealing day 14 April, irrevocable | Assets backing his units: short-dated government bonds in the liquid sleeve only, saleable on the day | Both texts rank equally. Neither allows payment in kind or a manager loan.

s1: Line managers acting on authority delegated by the Accessibility Officer (AO) shall comply with the staff declarations-of-interest code in every decision they take.
s2: The staff declarations-of-interest code forbids any manager from deciding a request that was made by one of their own direct reports.
s3: The AO delegates rulings on reasonable adjustment requests to each employee's direct line manager, who will settle every such request from their own reports.

s1: An arranged overdraft of EUR 1,000 or less carries no right of withdrawal, and the bank will state this in the overdraft terms.
s2: Under this policy, an arranged overdraft of more than EUR 1,000 on a current account counts as a consumer credit agreement (CCA).
s3: Every consumer credit agreement (CCA) shall give the customer 14 days to withdraw from it, as required by law.

s1: At least two staff should be on the shop floor during each minute of opening hours, so one can help customers while the other covers the tills.
s2: A shift worker shall be able to take a 20-minute break for each 6 hours worked, during the shift and away from the shop floor.
s3: On weekday late shifts, exactly two shift workers staff the shop, and both work the whole eight hours that the shop is open.

s1: Site survey and mission sheet, Corrow Quarry inspection: Terrain across the operating volume is level. The highest obstacle is the conveyor mast, top at 74 m AGL. RTH altitude is configured at 110 m AGL and cannot be changed in flight. The survey legs are flown at 60 m AGL, and C2 dropouts longer than 8 s are expected when the UA passes behind the mast.
s2: The UA shall not exceed 120 m AGL at any point in the flight, contingency procedures included.
s3: Vantor H6 Operations Manual, 7.3 Lost Link: The return-to-home altitude shall be set not less than 30 m above the highest obstacle within the operating volume. On loss of C2 link exceeding 8 s the UA climbs to that altitude before transiting home.

s1: Purchase book, Kelderby, line W-1180: | Seller: Aske Farms | 1,800 tonnes milling wheat | Agreed: Thursday 24 September | Cover deadline: Monday 28 September | The purchase is binding. Futures count as derivatives. The policy and the committee's resolution both stand; neither allows cover by other means or a longer review window.
s2: From 1 to 21 September, while the audit committee reviews hedging, the company enters into no new futures or any other derivative.
s3: Kelderby Milling, Commodity Risk Policy CRP-3, para 2.4: A wheat purchase of more than 500 tonnes is to be covered in full by exchange-traded futures no later than the second business day after it is agreed. Partial cover, waiting for price and reliance on offsetting sales are all ruled out.

s1: Stage winner Mia Dovrek covered the full fourth stage in 3 hours flat, the official timing shows, and she rode the whole route on her own bike without a change.
s2: Varra Sport, 'Dovrek storms stage four', 6 June, para. 2: The fourth stage of the Tour of Varra, from Orlo to Kestin, was 180 km long, the organisers said. They said the distance was measured along the race route and is exact.
s3: Team Calder performance file, stage four, 5 June: Dovrek's average speed over the full fourth stage was 48 km/h, according to the team's exact data, measured from start line to finish line. The team, the organisers and the timing office refer to the same stage and rider. Neither the timing office nor the team allows for a neutralised section, a shortened route or a time correction.

s1: By default, every licensed vessel in the coastal management zone (CMZ) must keep to its daily catch limit, and only an emergency rule can lift this.
s2: During any period designated as a declared fishery resource emergency, licensed vessels may exceed the standard daily catch limit to mitigate documented economic hardship, provided the harvest is reported within 48 hours.
s3: OBS-2: Whenever the trawler fleet is granted extended working hours during a crisis, an onboard observer must be placed on every boat taking part before nets go in the water.

s1: // Authentication must finish within 40 seconds of request arrival. Successful token validation is followed by exactly 2 seconds of authentication work.
s2: dovrek_token.c: /* validate_token rejects a token when fewer than 30 seconds have elapsed since issuance. At 30 seconds it becomes valid and remains valid for 60 seconds. Token age uses the process monotonic clock. */
s3: auth_window_test.c: /* A request arrives at monotonic time 0. Its sole token is issued at time 5 seconds. The request completes authentication using that token, with one successful validation attempt. No cached credentials, alternate authentication paths, replacement tokens, or clock adjustments are available. */

s1: Town clerk's file note, Wrenholt: On 9 June the watch committee, a municipal body, signed contract TW-41 with Ardell Locks for cell door repairs at the Quarry Lane lockup. On 11 June the Chief Constable certified TW-41 as a policing operations contract, and the certificate stands. On 19 June the clerk posted on the town notice board a sheet giving the name Ardell Locks and the price of 6,300 crowns, and nothing else. Both instruments bind the committee. Neither grants a waiver or any period beyond 21 days.
s2: No policing operations contract shall be made public, in whole or in part, beyond the name of the other party and the price.
s3: Contracts Transparency Ordinance (Wrenholt), s 12: Every municipal body shall, within 21 days after signing a contract to which it is a party, post the full text of that contract on the town notice board, except a contract certified by the Chief Constable as a policing operations contract, of which it shall post only the name of the other party and the price.

s1: IT incident note, Lindale Health Network, 6 May: The primary data centre failed at 10:00, and the courier left for the tape copy at once. The tape copy is kept 80 km away and takes 2 hours to bring in. Verifying it takes 3 hours and can start only once it is on site, and the restore then takes 1 hour. The EHR can come back online only through a restore. None of these times can be shortened. Both rules are in force. Neither provides for a standby copy, a partial verification, a longer target or a waiver.
s2: The EHR may be restored only from the off-site tape copy, and that copy shall be fully verified before the restore starts.
s3: Lindale Health Network, Disaster Recovery Standard, DR-01: After a failure of the primary data centre, the EHR shall be back online within 4 hours of the failure. Partial service, read-only access or paper downtime forms do not count as being back online.

s1: Each vehicle shall be checked in at the depot gate before the proof of delivery (POD) for its round is uploaded to the transport management system (TMS), since the upload goes over the depot Wi-Fi.
s2: Each driver's run sheet shall be closed before the vehicle is checked in at the depot gate.
s3: The proof of delivery (POD) for a round is uploaded to the transport management system (TMS) before the driver's run sheet for that round is closed, so billing picks up every completed drop the same day.

s1: All finalised laboratory and pathology results shall be visible to the patient in the MyChartway portal within 24 hours of reaching Final status.
s2: Results Release Procedure, Cellular Pathology: a histopathology report coded as malignant is not shown in the portal until it has been acknowledged in the results inbox by the ordering clinician or by a delegate listed in that clinician's cover pool.
s3: Portal release audit, Brackenhurst General: biopsy report HP-25-04417, coded malignant, reached Final status at 16:22 on 4 June. The ordering clinician, Dr Oyelaran, was on annual leave from 3 to 10 June and did not open her inbox. Dr Feldmark, listed in her cover pool, acknowledged the report at 08:47 on 5 June, and the portal displayed it to the patient at 08:47 the same morning.

s1: The lender shall be able to release an advance of €270,000 to the buyer for the purchase of the flat.
s2: Under the lender's offer document, the advance may be at most 75% of the property's value at the time the funds are released.
s3: The surveyor picked by the lender values the flat at €340,000, and that value holds when the funds are released.

s1: Ashcombe network asset register, entry MD-0311: The MRI scanner in building C sits on the medical device VLAN, its only network connection, and cannot be given a second connection. It is the hospital's only MRI scanner. The vendor's remote service can be reached only over the internet. NW-3 and the support contract are both in force. Neither provides for a modem link, a second scanner, periods of disconnection or a waiver.
s2: The MRI scanner shall stay connected to the vendor's remote service over the internet at all times, under the vendor support contract.
s3: Ashcombe General Hospital Network Security Standard, NW-3: Every device connected to the medical device VLAN shall have no internet access of any kind, inbound or outbound. The firewall for that VLAN blocks all internet traffic, and its rules cannot be changed for a single device.

s1: Every stablecoin balance held in a customer's wallet account can be moved to another account at any time, with no waiting period.
s2: Staked balances shall be locked for 30 days from the staking date and cannot be moved between accounts during that period.
s3: On 1 March, customer C-882 staked 5,000 USDC, and the staked amount stays in that customer's wallet account as a stablecoin balance.

s1: The wagon shall stay within 2 inches of an escort unit at all times.
s2: Scenario setup diagram, River Crossing: The only escort unit is the Pike Guard, which moves at most 4 inches per turn. The wagon moves up to 6 inches per turn. At the start the wagon and the Pike Guard stand side by side, 18 inches from the bridge, on open ground. No other unit can join the escort. Both rules are in force for the scenario. Neither provides for a forced march, a road bonus, a second escort or a fourth turn.
s3: Ironfront Scenario Book, 'River Crossing', victory condition V-1: The supply wagon must reach the bridge by the end of turn 3. If it has not reached the bridge then, the defender wins and the game ends.

s1: All personal data held by the compliance function shall be erased no later than three years after the project it relates to closes.
s2: On the day a person receives inside information, the compliance function adds an entry with the person's name, reason and time of access, so every entry is personal data.
s3: The compliance function shall keep every insider list entry for five years after the price-sensitive project closes.

s1: Veska was the first person aboard to notice the gas leak in the lower hab.
s2: Series bible, Lower Hab, Characters: The android Veska has no sense of smell, and she never gains one in any chapter of the book.
s3: Incident note, lower hab, as given in Ch. 10: The leak made no sound, showed no vapour and set off no alarm or instrument. The only way anyone could notice it was by its smell. The note is accurate. It admits no second leak and no earlier report, and the text must keep to this.

s1: Islecrest Air Operations Control, plan for 9 September: The three inbound flights due at Corbel Island between 14.00 and 14.40 shall land there at their scheduled times. None may be diverted or held.
s2: Corbel Island Airport occurrence log, 9 September: At 13.55 an aircraft bursts a tyre on landing at Corbel Island, which has one runway. The damaged aircraft is cleared from the runway at 14.05, and the full inspection then takes 60 minutes; it cannot start before the aircraft is cleared. No partial reopening or taxiway landing is allowed, and the plan admits no diversion or hold for the three flights.
s3: After a tyre burst on landing, the runway shall stay closed until a full runway inspection is finished, and no aircraft may land or take off on it meanwhile.

s1: The Regional Distribution Hub maintains a cold-chain certification, which mandates continuous refrigeration of all goods it handles.
s2: All perishable goods should be kept between 2°C and 8°C throughout the entire cold chain, from the point of origin to final delivery.
s3: All outbound shipments, including perishable goods, shall pass through the Regional Distribution Hub before reaching their final delivery points.

s1: Corrowmere Museum of Craft, Label Standard LS-4, cl. 2.1: Where the museum knows when a piece was made, that year is printed on its label; where it does not, the line is left off and no guess is printed. Lent pieces and the museum's own holdings are treated alike.
s2: Objects lent by the Stannard family trust are to go on show with labels that carry no year or other date at all, whether of making, purchase or gift.
s3: Registrar's record, Corrowmere Museum, case 11: | Object: pewter tankard, loan no. ST-14 from the Stannard family trust | Year of making: not known; the maker's mark is worn away and no ledger or bill of sale survives | Label: name, material, lender | On display until March 2028 | The label stays in the case for the whole loan. Both the standard and the loan terms apply in full, with no exception claimed under either.

s1: INV-6: A store in stocktake mode is blocked from booking in goods transferred from sister branches until the count ends.
s2: A store in stocktake mode shall still book in every delivery due that day, to avoid waste.
s3: The Riverside store is in stocktake mode for the whole of Sunday, and its only delivery due that Sunday is a transfer of bread and dairy from a sister branch.

s1: Birch Court, Accessibility Brief, item 1: Every flat at Birch Court, including those on the top floor, shall be reachable by a passenger lift. Stair lifts and platform lifts do not count as a passenger lift.
s2: Tanner Lifts, lift study LS-1, Birch Court: Birch Court lies in the Birch Hill Conservation Area. The top floor sits directly under the roof, so any passenger lift reaching it needs an overrun rising 1.2 m above the current roofline. No lift type avoids this, and the top floor cannot be lowered. The brief counts no stair lift or platform lift, and the roofline rule makes no exception for lift overruns.
s3: The roofline of a building in the Birch Hill Conservation Area shall not rise at any point, front or rear.

s1: New accessions: cataloguing should not start until the appraisal report for the accession has been signed.
s2: The box list, the draft finding aid, is produced by the processing archivist only after cataloguing of the accession has started.
s3: The appraisal of a new accession is based on its box list, so the appraisal report is signed after the box list has been produced.

s1: On every benefits application form, the date picker is left out of the focus order, which shortens navigation for users who type the date straight into the input box.
s2: A form counts as keyboard-usable only if every field on it, date pickers included, can be reached with the Tab key.
s3: Whenever a user opens an application form on the benefits portal, the form shall be fully keyboard-usable, so that it can be completed without a mouse.

s1: F-12 The geo-location dashboard shall be able to place each site visitor on the map, and it needs stored client IP addresses to do so.
s2: In anonymised mode, the site should not store any visitor's IP address.
s3: The site runs in anonymised mode around the clock, as the privacy impact assessment (Section 6) requires.

s1: Erasure test E6: The application receives Neral’s erasure request exactly one hour after creating audit record A17. A17 contains Neral’s home address in plaintext. This address is personal data covered by the request, and the audit store is an application store. Removal means deleting the stored bytes, not restricting access.
s2: Audit storage requirements: Retain every audit record in application storage byte-for-byte unchanged for 30 days after its creation.
s3: Within 24 hours of receiving an erasure request, remove every stored occurrence of the requester’s personal data from all application stores.

s1: The archive will not show any record in the web finding aid while that record is closed to access.
s2: Staff files from the Printing Office deposit will be closed to access for 75 years to protect former employees.
s3: The archive lists staff files from the Printing Office deposit in the web finding aid only after their 75-year closure period has ended.

s1: Milk round leaflet, Brennick Dairy, 1 May: we fill each bottle only with this morning's milk from our own herd of Jerseys, nothing bought from other dairies and nothing left over from yesterday
s2: Delivery sheet, Brennick Dairy, 4 May: | There are 132 bottles ordered by midnight, one per order | The morning milking of the herd yields at least 140 litres, and the dairy keeps no other cows | No milk from that milking goes to any other use, and no order can be cancelled | Neither the milk promise nor the delivery rule allows a bought-in bottle or a late round.
s3: Every order placed by midnight shall be delivered the next morning, one 1-litre bottle per order, with no order held back.

s1: The approving compliance officer shall be able to authorize the final sign-off in the quarterly financial statement validation process using the master audit certificate.
s2: The master audit certificate can be assigned to only one compliance officer at a time, and every reassignment must wait through a 48-hour cooling-off period.
s3: Every customer transaction shall go through a 48-hour hold period before settlement for anti-money laundering (AML) compliance.

s1: The CMO may delegate sign-off of minor incident reviews only, and never of serious incident reviews, to a deputy medical director.
s2: Under the CGC, sign-off of every serious incident review must stay solely with the CMO personally and be recorded in the governance log.
s3: Whenever the chief medical officer (CMO) hands over a task, both the handover and the stand-in's actions shall fall under the Clinical Governance Charter (CGC).

s1: A study classified as greater-than-minimal-risk research shall not involve vulnerable populations unless it offers those participants the prospect of direct benefit and no comparable alternative exists outside research.
s2: No pilot study with vulnerable populations shall be conducted without prior ethics board approval of the main research protocol.

s1: Orrin PS-3 Power Supply, Component Protection Requirements, CP-09: The voltage across varistor RV1 shall not exceed 420 V, AC or DC, at any time between manufacture and disposal of the unit, whether the unit is powered, unpowered or under test. No exemption applies to factory procedures.
s2: Orrin PS-3 Power Supply, Production Test Requirements, PT-04: Every completed unit shall undergo a dielectric withstand test in which 1500 V AC is applied for 60 s between the mains terminals L and N, joined together, and the earth terminal PE. The test shall be made on the fully assembled unit; no component shall be removed, disconnected or shorted, and no reduced voltage, shorter duration or sample testing shall be substituted. PS-3 units are in series production.
s3: Orrin PS-3 Hardware Description, §2.6 Input Protection: RV1 is soldered directly between terminal L and terminal PE and is potted with the input board during assembly, before the unit is complete. There is no switch, link, fuse or series element in this path, and RV1 cannot be isolated once potted. The voltage across RV1 therefore equals the voltage between L and PE at all times. All PS-3 units are built to this design; no variant without RV1 exists.

s1: queue.offer() must never block the calling thread when the event queue is full, not even for a moment.
s2: ingest/src/main/java/EventJob.java, line 31, delivery guarantee: Every event that reaches queue.offer() in the Pellam clickstream job must be processed exactly once, never lost and never processed twice. The guarantee covers spikes as well as quiet hours, and the analytics contract allows no loss rate at all.
s3: Incident note INC-2291, Pellam ingest, 1 May: Between 12:00 and 12:20 the bounded event queue filled, and new events kept reaching queue.offer() while it was full. The queue size is fixed at start-up and cannot be raised. With the queue full, offer() can only wait for space or drop the event, and a dropped event is never processed. The job has no second queue, spill file or replay from the source, and neither comment leaves room for a short wait.
