s3: A student can upload the learning agreement to the mobility portal only after enrolment in the exchange modules it lists has been confirmed.

s1: Duty roster, Halden Pass border post, week of 3 to 9 March 2025: Halden Pass is a designated border post and remains designated throughout the week. Three officers of the Service are assigned to it: Ms. Edda Varnholt, Mr. Piet Lasker and Mr. Joran Múlvey. No other officer is assigned, seconded, on call or transferable to Halden Pass from any other post, reserve or agency on any day of that week.
s2: Orrenfell Frontier Service Standing Order 4: Two officers of the Service shall be on duty at each designated border post at every moment of every calendar day. No closure, suspension or reduced-hours operation applies, and persons who are not officers of the Service do not count.
s3: No officer shall be on duty for more than 12 hours in any calendar day.

s1: Services coordination record: Room B1 will be occupied in the completed building. Every outdoor-air supply path to B1 passes through opening P2; there are no other supply routes or stored-air supplies. The specified solid firestop is airtight across the entire opening, with no duct, sleeve or other passage through it.
s2: Orven Archive—ventilation conditions: Supply outdoor air to basement room B1 continuously during occupancy at a rate of not less than 60 litres per second.
s3: Install and maintain a solid firestop across opening P2 throughout occupancy of room B1.

s1: The 132 kV busbar shall be livened only once generator GT2 is running, as the black-start plan sets out.
s2: ENV-2 The district office shall be able to issue the ecological authorisation after the landowner consent certificate is lodged, usually within 8 weeks.
s3: Landowner consent certificates can be lodged only once the approved network connection assessment is attached.

s1: All CMR substances held on site shall be kept in locked cabinets.
s2: The quality control lab measures out its CMR reference standards in open beakers and then stores them in a locked CMR cabinet.
s3: Any CMR substance used only in closed sample vials is exempt from the locked-cabinet rule.

s1: API lot LT-5530, received last week from an approved vendor with a qualified CoA, must still go through the full QC re-test before use, like every other lot.
s2: QC shall fully re-test every incoming API lot before use, with no waivers, because identity mix-ups are the site's main recall risk.
s3: The badge system records every entry time, and the badge log must be reviewed every week.

s1: Dunholt Engineering training officer, apprentice A-31: Karim Elstow is an apprentice on the night-shift rotation, and he works a night shift every Tuesday, including every Tuesday in term. The rota is fixed for the year and cannot be changed for one apprentice. Wednesday is the day after Tuesday. College attendance counts as training. Both clauses bind the apprentice and the employer. Neither provides for an evening class, a remote session or a waiver.
s2: Apprenticeship Agreement between Dunholt Engineering Ltd and its apprentices, cl. 5: Every apprentice shall attend college on every Wednesday in term.
s3: Apprentices on the night-shift rotation shall not attend any training on the day after a night shift.

s1: A graduate student whose cumulative GPA stays below 3.0 for two semesters in a row will be moved to Academic Probation status from the next enrollment period.
s2: Under the campus testing calendar, every block of three straight weeks in the term must contain a week with a major test.
s3: The academic office must hold an academic progress review every 4 weeks of the semester for every student on Academic Probation.

s1: Joint purchasing pools are exempt from notification to the Compliance Office under the group competition policy.
s2: The following are treated as horizontal agreements: a) benchmarking clubs; b) joint ventures; c) joint purchasing pools, such as the steel pool the group joined in 2025.
s3: Every horizontal agreement will be notified to the Compliance Office together with a short competition assessment, with no exception.

s1: New hires will complete their background verification before they can be enrolled in the company benefits program.
s2: Every new employee must receive an official employee ID badge from HR, and only then can the HR department start the background verification process.
s3: The background verification process requires the employee to first submit a signed authorization form and at least three professional references, which HR validates within ten business days.

s1: Lindhafen Aerodrome Manual, Rule AR-6: While the single runway is in use, it shall be closed and inspected for debris, with no more than 2 hours passing between the end of one inspection and the start of the next. Each inspection closes the runway for 15 minutes, and no aircraft may land during it.
s2: On 21 March the runway shall accept one arrival every 2 minutes from 07:00 to 08:30, without a break.
s3: Lindhafen tower log, 21 March: The runway was in use without a pause from 05:00 to 22:00. Its last inspection before 07:00 ended at 06:10, and no inspection can be carried out except by closing the runway. Lindhafen has one runway, and arrivals cannot be moved to any other aerodrome. Both the manual and the slot plan applied that day. Neither provides for an inspection between landings, a shorter closure, a deferred inspection or any gap in the arrival stream.

s1: Marlowe Ridge Health, Adult Sepsis Bundle, 2.3: Give the first dose of intravenous broad-spectrum antibiotic within 60 minutes of sepsis recognition. Do not delay the dose to wait for investigations.
s2: Draw two sets of peripheral blood cultures before the first antibiotic dose, provided this can be done within 45 minutes of sepsis recognition; if not, give the antibiotic and culture afterwards.
s3: Acute Medical Unit nursing note, 22:50: 64F, rigors, temp 39.4, HR 124, BP 88/52, lactate 4.1. Sepsis recognised 22:05 by medical registrar. Difficult venous access, two failed attempts. Vascular access nurse sited cannula 22:30. Two sets of peripheral blood cultures drawn 22:34 and 22:38. Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 g IV started 22:44. Here 60 minutes from sepsis recognition ends at 23:05.

s1: Line 3 will run the nut-free cereal bar each Friday as the weekly allergen-free batch.
s2: Nut-free products should not be made on a line that has nut-dosing equipment of any kind fitted to it.
s3: Line 3 has a nut-dosing hopper bolted permanently to its mixer for the trail mix range.

s1: From sunset until sunrise that same night, the storm remained continuously imprisoned by the copper seal beneath the keep.
s2: Chapter 22 — At midnight, Talven freed the captive child Iset from the copper seal beneath the keep.
s3: Worldbuilding notes — The copper seal beneath the keep has only two states: it holds both Iset and the storm captive, or it holds neither. This bond governs the actual child and storm throughout their existence; distance, death, substitution, and magic cannot separate their captivity.

s1: Caldmoor Neurology Clinic, Seizure Record, Mr Petrov, 20 February: Mr Petrov had a generalised epileptic seizure at home on 14 February this year, witnessed by his wife and confirmed on EEG. It was a true epileptic seizure and not a faint, and the diagnosis will not be revised. He has been told of the licensing rule and has not driven since. The licensing rule grants no exemption and no medical waiver, and there is no restricted licence for short routes.
s2: No person who has had an epileptic seizure may drive a bus or coach for five years after that seizure.
s3: Caldmoor Transport Occupational Health, Return-to-Work Plan for Mr Ivan Petrov, 48, bus driver, 3 March: From 1 June this year Mr Petrov shall be back at work, driving buses on passenger routes. The plan has been agreed with his depot manager, and his contract allows no later start date.

s1: The customer account can only be activated once the KYC file is marked complete.
s2: The KYC file is marked complete once source of funds is evidenced, meaning the first incoming transfer from the customer's own account is credited to a holding ledger, which never requires an active account.
s3: The customer's risk rating is recalculated whenever the customer's address, occupation or ownership structure changes (see Section 4.5).

s1: Margin requirements shall be fully calculated and documented before the institution can submit the account for regulatory reporting.
s2: A designated compliance officer who reviews a suitability assessment for margin account authorization shall record the approval in the firm's central compliance register and keep supporting documentation for at least seven years, per applicable recordkeeping obligations.
s3: The compliance officer may approve a margin account only after its regulatory reporting is fully completed and acknowledged by the oversight authority, and that reporting never waits on compliance approval.

s1: Ferry office boarding sheet, Friday: 380 passengers booked and all present | two gates, no more | each gate checks 8 passengers a minute. The ticket rule and the boarding time both apply, and the ferry office allows no exemption.
s2: Boarding for the Kittle evening ferry shall be open for 25 minutes only.
s3: Kittle Island Ferry News, 'Ticket checks before sailing', 6 June 2026: Every passenger on the Kittle evening ferry must have a ticket checked at the gate before the boat leaves, the ferry office said.

s1: Calloway stroke unit transfer log, 3 August: Mr Felix Dorr was admitted to the stroke unit at 08:00 on 2 August and remains a stroke unit patient. At 08:00 on 3 August, 24 hours after admission, he went into the MRI scanner room for a diffusion-weighted scan. MN-2 and the scanner room rule are both in force. Neither provides for an MRI-safe telemetry pack, a scan at another site, a delay of the scan or a waiver.
s2: No telemetry pack shall be taken into, or worn inside, the MRI scanner room at any time.
s3: Calloway Stroke Unit Monitoring Rules, MN-2: Every patient on the stroke unit shall wear a telemetry pack at all times during the first 72 hours after admission, including during transfers and tests. Telemetry readings are shown at the unit's central station.

s1: AG-15: Class C sprayers shall not be used on any field that borders the primary school, to keep spray drift away from the children.
s2: AG-16: The farm shall be able to carry out the fungicide pass on Field 12, which borders the primary school, with drone D-2, a Class A sprayer, because the ground is too wet for the tractor.
s3: The farm manager may hand over sign-off of the spray records, about 30 per season, to the senior tractor driver.

s1: Fernwerk GmbH Huddlr Guidelines, section 4.2: no customer names may be posted in any public Huddlr channel, in messages, files or threads. Public channels can be read by every employee and by guest accounts, and Legal makes no carve-outs.
s2: Each outage report must be posted in #incidents and must list every affected customer by full company name, so account managers can act fast.
s3: Fernwerk IT ops file note, @svenja_ops, 11 November: #incidents is a public channel, and that setting stays as is. Today's outage at 09.40 hit 14 customers, and its outage report is due today. The report cannot be skipped or moved to another channel. Both the guidelines and the incident rule apply in full. Neither permits an exemption, a waiver, customer numbers in place of names, a report in another channel, or any delay.

s1: CLN-2: Every urgent care services (UCS) location shall record a NEWS2 value for any adult who arrives with a raised temperature, so worsening cases are spotted early.
s2: Nurse-led walk-in clinics do not record a NEWS2 value for any patient (see Section 5.4).
s3: Under Section 2.1, nurse-led walk-in clinics, including the two at the retail park, count as UCS locations and see adults with raised temperatures every day.

s1: Fernwick animal handling note, Pip, 12 February: Pip flew on FW330, which departed Brakely on 12 February. His veterinary passport records him as a French bulldog, and the annexed breed list names the French bulldog as short-nosed. The departure date is recorded by the airport and cannot be changed. ACR-6 binds Fernwick. It allows no other exception.
s2: Ms Hanna Lowe's French bulldog Pip travelled in the hold of Fernwick Air flight FW330 from Brakely to Ostmere, and the carriage was lawful.
s3: Fernwick Air Animal Carriage Rules, ACR-6: Dogs and cats of a short-nosed breed shall not travel in the hold on any flight departing between 1 May and 30 September inclusive. The breed list annexed to ACR-6 decides which breeds are short-nosed.

s1: The Session Authentication Module (SAM) may begin its initialization sequence only once the User Profile Cache (UPC) is fully populated and its integrity checks have passed.
s2: User Profile Cache (UPC) population must not start while the Payment Processing Service (PPS) is in any state other than 'inactive', since parallel access during active payments would corrupt shared records.
s3: The platform shall complete the record-transfer component only once the Session Authentication Module (SAM) is fully set up and approved for live use.

s1: Sponsor brief, Brewhaus Coffee and the Two Hosts podcast, clause 3, signed 2 May: each sponsored episode runs at least 60 minutes from intro to outro, published as one file. Clip episodes and two-parters don't count.
s2: No episode published on a free Castwell plan may run longer than 45 minutes, counted from the first second to the last.
s3: Castwell account record, Two Hosts podcast, 12 May: The account is on the Free plan, renewed monthly, and the plan cannot be changed this month. Every episode is published on Castwell and nowhere else. This week's episode is sponsored by Brewhaus and goes up on Thursday as usual. Both the brief and the plan limit apply to it. Brewhaus grants no waiver, and two parts do not count as one episode.

s1: Transport Planning Ordinance of Orsland, s. 12: A draft transport plan shall be put out for comment for a minimum of six weeks. Adoption before the comment window shuts is unlawful.
s2: Each council's transport plan must be in force by the last day of the term for which that council was elected.
s3: Committee minutes, Brindlecombe council, 1 March 2027: The draft transport plan was published and consultation opened today. The council's term ends on 30 April 2027, and a full council meeting is booked for 22 April 2027 to adopt the plan. Both texts bind the council. Neither allows an extended term or a shortened consultation.

s1: Medical Cannabis Act (Kingdom of Solvik), s. 3: Cannabis flower may be dispensed by a pharmacy only on a prescription written by a specialist doctor. A prescription from a general practitioner, a nurse or a foreign doctor does not count, and the pharmacist has no power to dispense without one.
s2: A specialist may prescribe cannabis flower only after at least two other licensed treatments for the condition have been tried and have failed.
s3: Pharmacy inspectorate file note, Solvik, case MC-26-118: Mr Anders Berg was dispensed cannabis flower for his chronic back pain in May 2026, and the dispensing was lawful. Before then he had tried only one licensed treatment for that pain, gabapentin, which failed. His treatment history is complete and cannot be changed. Both sections are in force. Neither provides for a trial prescription, a treatment counted twice, or a prescription for a different condition.

s1: Every related-party transaction (RPT) shall be reviewed by the board's audit committee before it is signed.
s2: Section 4.2: Every audit committee review shall rest on a written opinion from the statutory auditor on the pricing and disclosure of the deal.
s3: The proposed office lease from the CEO's family company is an RPT, and the statutory auditor's independence rules bar it from giving any opinion on that lease.

s1: Each virtual machine (VM) in the production VPC will be patched and rebooted automatically on Sunday nights.
s2: All database primaries run as VMs inside the production VPC.
s3: Database primaries should not be restarted automatically, because the DBA team plans their restarts and failovers.

s1: Pilot craft must log 3 days of trials at sea, beyond the harbour mouth, before their owner takes them over. A day counts only if the craft spends it in open water.
s2: Trials note, Calder Boatworks, PC-3: The cutter was ready for trials on 6 December. A gale warning kept her inside the harbour from 6 to 9 December; open water was clear from 10 December onward. Trials ran on 10, 11 and 12 December. Handover after trials takes one day. Harbour trials do not count, and the handover date cannot be moved.
s3: Vessel Construction Order, Calder Boatworks and Tarn Pilotage Service, cl. 9: Calder shall hand over pilot cutter PC-3 to Tarn Pilotage by 15 December. The cutter must be crewed and fitted for service on handover, and no later date has been agreed.

s1: Plate 6 publication record: The published thumbnail is a group portrait of exactly four sitters: Mara Vesk, Tovin Arl, Nessa Brin and Calen Dorr. These are their complete registered names. Its single caption contains all four names and the required credit “Photograph by Oren Pell,” with no other text.
s2: Vennor Gallery caption guide: Every group portrait’s single caption must name every sitter using their complete registered names. Initials and collective labels are not permitted.
s3: Thumbnail captions contain a maximum of 12 words, counting the photographer credit. Words are counted as space-separated tokens.

s1: Roads Authority file note, Tarnland, 11 January 2027: In 2027, 900 road bridges in public use are due a principal inspection, none has yet been inspected, and none can be taken out of public use during the year. The roster names two engineers, Ilse Varga and Tomas Brenn, and no name can be added before 2029. Each of them can complete at most 200 principal inspections in a calendar year. Both texts are in force. No exemption, waiver, deferral or delegated inspection is available.
s2: Bridge Safety Code of Tarnland, art. 11: Every road bridge in public use shall receive a principal inspection once in each calendar year. An inspection missed in one year shall not be carried into the next, and a visual check by a road crew is not a principal inspection.
s3: A principal inspection of a road bridge may be carried out only by an engineer named on the national roster of bridge inspectors.

s1: A building will not receive its occupancy certificate until the building certifier has approved it for occupation.
s2: The full-building evacuation audit can take place only once the occupancy certificate has been issued.
s3: All load-bearing structural columns shall be encased in concrete fireproofing before the building can receive its occupancy certificate.

s1: The patent team shall file national phase entries (NPEs) for patent family F-118 in JP, KR and CN this year, because all three 30-month deadlines fall in November.
s2: Each national phase entry (NPE) for patent family F-118 in JP, KR or CN costs at least EUR 11,000 once translation and official fees are included.
s3: All prosecution costs for patent family F-118 this year, including every official and translation fee, must be paid from its annual budget, which is capped at EUR 30,000.

s1: The authority's Publication Scheme (PS), which lists the classes of information it publishes as a matter of routine, shall be reviewed at least once every 12 months.
s2: The Records Manager reviews the PS once every two years and at no other time.
s3: Only the Records Manager may review the PS, because the review sets which records are published without an FOI request.

s1: The warehouse may start setting aside shelf space for inbound stock only once the purchase order has been sent and the vendor has acknowledged it.
s2: A procurement officer will not issue a purchase order to a critical supplier until the supplier has successfully completed the vendor qualification process.
s3: No purchase order (PO) may be issued to any vendor whose supplier qualification the procurement team has not finished and approved.

s1: Commission staff file note, chapter 10 annex: On Flight 590 from Arlen, passenger N. was selected by the screening system and had one checked bag. He boarded with the other passengers, and the flight left with his bag in the hold. Both rules were in force that day, and neither allowed a waiver or for a bag to be sent on a later flight.
s2: Every checked bag shall be loaded onto the aircraft before boarding of the flight begins, and no bag may be loaded after that point.
s3: Final Report of the Harwell Commission, chapter 10, p. 341: Under the airport's rules, the checked bag of any selected passenger had to be kept off the aircraft until that passenger had boarded. The report found no case in which the rule was waived.

s1: Whenever premiums are being recomputed, the Claims Adjudication Division must hold the wet-ink master of the policy rider dossier to confirm the loss payment the insured is due.
s2: Under the single-original document control protocol, the original signed policy endorsement file must be held by only one departmental unit at any moment.
s3: Under Section 4.2 of the Master Coverage Agreement, the original signed certificate of insurance may be held by only one authorized custodian at any moment.

s1: Merrow Air Maintenance Organisation Exposition, MOE 2.16: No aircraft shall fly after maintenance unless a certificate of release to service has been signed for that work by an engineer whose licence was valid at the moment of signing. A certificate signed on an expired licence has no effect.
s2: The aircraft LN-MRW flew passengers lawfully from Orsby on 9 November, the day after scheduled maintenance at Orsby.
s3: Merrow technical records note, LN-MRW, 10 November: The release to service for the 8 November maintenance was signed at 17:30 that day by licensed engineer Kari Voss. Her licence was valid until 12 November and was not suspended. The certificate covers all work done, and the records cannot be amended. MOE 2.16 binds Merrow without exception.

s1: Anyone exercising delegated power to approve a premium tier feature for release must fully follow the information security control standard (ISCS), including every sign-off step of the mandatory security review.
s2: All premium tier features are classified as core product functionality.
s3: Core product functionality will undergo a mandatory security review before each release cycle.

s1: The year-end close group will keep the bank authorisation smartcard from the start to the end of 2 January to sign off the closing entries.
s2: CTL-2: The bank authorisation smartcard should be held by one team at a time and should not be shared between two teams.
s3: Payroll should hold the bank authorisation smartcard all day on 2 January to release the January salaries before the bank's cut-off.

s1: Orrinway Buses, Roadside Screens Handbook RS-3, rule 2: When the network diagram is on screen, its caption shall list the name of every interchange marked on it, spelled out as on the signage. Interchanges may not be numbered or grouped.
s2: Screen content log, Orrinway, slot 7: | Image: network diagram, winter edition | Interchanges marked: 5 | Each name: 10 characters as signed | Separator: comma and space | The caption holds the list only | The diagram cannot be redrawn this winter. The guide and the limit both apply, and neither provides for an override or a scrolling caption.
s3: Captions shown on the Orrinway roadside screens shall not exceed 64 characters, spaces included, because the screen software cuts off anything longer without warning.

s1: The licensing office shall not publish a protected resident’s full legal name in the public permit register while protective status is active.
s2: Deren Borough case log: A trading permit was issued to Nella Voss on 14 September 2027. Nella Voss is the holder’s full legal name. Her protective status remained active throughout that entire calendar day.
s3: Permit Disclosure Order: The licensing office shall publish each permit holder’s full legal name in the public permit register on the permit’s issue date.

s1: Kell Weekly, 'Radio Kell licence renewed', 7 July 2026, para. 3: Under its new broadcasting licence, Radio Kell must air at least 30 hours of Kell-language programmes in every week. The regulator said programmes count only when they are spoken in Kell, and that music shows with Kell titles do not count toward the total.
s2: Radio Kell shall relay the national news service, which is in Corlish only, for 85 hours in every week, under the same licence.
s3: Kell Weekly, same report, para. 6: Radio Kell may broadcast only from 06:00 to 22:00 each day on its single frequency, and it has no second channel or online stream that counts under the licence. It can air only one programme at a time, and the national news relay contains no Kell. Both terms of the licence apply in every week. Neither allows a bilingual programme to count twice, a second frequency, a cut in the relay hours or a waiver.

s1: Bramholt Air duty record, 10 May: | Crew: Captain Jonas Brekke and First Officer Siv Lind | Duty start: 05:40 | Sectors: Fjellby to Rydalen, Rydalen to Fjellby, Fjellby to Osker, Osker to Fjellby | No further sector is planned that day. Both documents applied, with no waiver granted.
s2: No crew shall fly more than 4 sectors in a duty that starts before 06:00.
s3: Bramholt Air Island Network Roster, rule 6.2: A crew rostered on the Fjellby island shuttle shall fly every sector of that duty. Crew control cannot split the duty between crews.

s1: Window fitters are to use the Block B goods hoist from 08:00 to 09:30 every Monday, as programme rev. C sets out.
s2: Under the one-trade limit at Block B, no more than one trade at a time should use the goods hoist.
s3: The roofing team will have the Block B goods hoist from 07:00 to 10:00 every Monday to lift tiles and battens.

s1: CLEARVAULT rates clients with a machine-learning engine that keeps revising each rating against peer groups, and the bank uses it solely for standard customers, never for EDD on politically exposed persons (PEPs).
s2: Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) procedures shall be initiated within 15 business days of onboarding for any customer classified as a Politically Exposed Person (PEP), and require verification of source-of-wealth documentation and senior management sign-off.
s3: Supervisory guidance on model risk management requires that any customer risk-scoring system using continuous peer-cohort behavioral benchmarking be excluded from enhanced due diligence (EDD) risk assessments on politically exposed persons (PEPs), to prevent inadvertent profiling-by-association.

s1: Captions published in the junior edition must not contain the word “damn” in any capitalization.
s2: Publication sheet: Photograph R8 features one protest placard reading “Damn this toll” and is being published in the junior edition with one caption. The wording is fully legible. This release also includes protest-placard photographs published only in the adult edition and junior-edition wildlife photographs featuring no protest placards. Edition assignments are final.
s3: Brindlepress caption guide: For every photograph featuring a protest placard, reproduce the placard’s complete wording verbatim in the published caption.

s1: Catch returns from the Fisheries Trust's 14 beats usually show 300 to 450 salmon a year, with a few grilse in wet summers.
s2: The Fisheries Trust collects the completed catch returns in December, after the season has closed, and enters them into the regional catch database by March.
s3: Catch return forms are posted to every permit holder in early November.

s1: Westrill Laboratory Interface Manual: At verification, publish every chemistry result to its patient's portal account, including the measured value and reference interval.
s2: Never publish results designated RESEARCH-ONLY to any patient portal, at any time.
s3: Verification batch log: Result R81 was verified today; it is a chemistry result designated RESEARCH-ONLY, and its patient's portal account exists. These classifications are permanent. The batch also verified R82, a chemistry result without that designation, and R83, a microbiology result designated RESEARCH-ONLY. All three results contain measured values and reference intervals.

s1: The warning letter for a plan year should not be sent until that year's contributions are finalised on 31 October.
s2: Whenever a member's contributions for a plan year go above the yearly cap, the plan shall send that member a warning letter before the savings statement for that same year.
s3: The savings statement for each plan year should reach members no later than 5 October of that year.

s1: On Sanphet routes, chicken satay with peanut sauce shall be served as the starter to every business class passenger on every flight. The starter cannot be replaced by another dish.
s2: Saphira Royal catering record, flight SR917 Kestwick to Sanphet City, 1 March: Mr Oliver Hall has declared a peanut allergy for SR917, accepted at booking, and the declaration cannot be withdrawn. 30 passengers fly in business class. Both documents apply. Neither provides for a waiver, a peanut-free satay or service of the dish after landing.
s3: Saphira Royal Catering Policy CP-4, section 3: When a passenger has declared a peanut allergy, no food containing peanuts shall be served anywhere on that flight, in any cabin. The declaration binds the airline once it is accepted at booking.

s1: The store shall destroy every recoverable representation of a requested payload within 60 seconds after validating its erasure request.
s2: Velmara Archive Profile: The store shall retain each received payload in recoverable form continuously for 3,600 seconds after receipt.
s3: Acceptance trace E9: The store received payload P at elapsed time 0 seconds and validated an erasure request for P at elapsed time 10 seconds. Both timestamps use the same clock. Recoverable representations include originals, replicas, backups and encoded forms from which the payload can be reconstructed.

s1: #standards-desk, Sat 7 June, 00:40, from Priya_M: standards desk confirmed at 00:35 today that Thursday's @HarlowDispatch post on the ferry fares gives the wrong figure. It is a factual error and the confirmation stands. The original post is still up.
s2: Polling-weekend silence | @HarlowDispatch | no posts, replies or quote-posts published from 00:00 Sat 7 June to 22:00 Sun 8 June
s3: Harlow Dispatch Social Media Standards, Corrections: When the standards desk confirms a factual error in a post from a Dispatch account, that same account must publish a correction as a reply under the original post, after the confirmation and no later than 24 hours after it. Deleting the post, or correcting from another account, does not satisfy this.

s1: Fuelling shall not take place at any stand while more than two ground support equipment (GSE) units are parked there, because of the fire risk.
s2: Step 3 of every quick turnaround (QTA) will include topping up the aircraft's fuel tanks at the stand while the passengers are off board.
s3: During a QTA, the baggage tractor, one catering truck and the lavatory service truck stay parked at the stand for the whole turnaround, so three GSE units in all.

s1: No patient's name may remain anywhere on a scan kept in the teaching library, whether in its header fields or written into the pixel data itself.
s2: Imaging records log, Calder Royal Infirmary, 2 February: | Scan T-412: knee MRI slice, in the teaching library and under hold LH-17, one shared file | Lettering in the pixels: scan date 14.10.2025 and scanner code CR-3 only | Patient name: in a header field only, cleared on 30 January | No copy of the file exists. Both the library rule and the hold notice apply, and neither has been lifted.
s3: Calder Royal Infirmary, Litigation Hold Notice LH-17, item 2: While this hold is in force, any lettering that forms part of the pixel data of a held scan must be preserved untouched, and nobody may erase, mask or edit a single character of it.

s1: Talvren Equipment Lease: The Lessee shall reimburse the Lessor for the full invoiced repair cost of every machine returned damaged.
s2: The Lessee’s aggregate repair reimbursement liability for the entire lease term shall not exceed £12,000.
s3: Final return account: At expiry, all three leased machines were returned damaged and repaired. The sole repair invoices charge £4,100 for the lathe, £3,800 for the press and £3,900 for the mill, including all labour, parts and taxes. No other repair liability arose during the term. No insurance proceeds, credits or third-party contributions are available.

s1: A risk rating upgrade from 'medium' to 'high' after a triggered reassessment requires an updated Customer Due Diligence (CDD) profile, including re-verification of beneficial ownership for entities with 25% or greater equity interests, within 45 days of the triggering event.
s2: A valid signed contractual agreement with a virtual asset service provider (VASP) counterparty requires a successfully completed third-party due diligence assessment, including an on-site audit of the counterparty's AML controls infrastructure.
s3: The institution's automated sanctions screening workflow must be completed, with a clean result confirmed, before any third-party due diligence assessment or on-site audit of a prospective VASP counterparty may begin.

s1: Reels of Marrowby, Ch. 12 as printed: At the harvest dance Jory played the Wren's Reel on his fiddle, every bar, with his own two hands. The printed narration of this book is never false or mistaken.
s2: Tune book printed in the appendix, Marrowby: Wren's Reel | stopped on the fiddle with the first three fingers of the left hand only | no note in it needs the little finger. The appendix allows no other setting of the reel.
s3: Old Jory Penhale lost the little finger of his left hand in the Tarn quarry blast, long before the book begins, and it never grew back.

s1: Flight-test record M17: Depressurization occurred with eight passenger stations occupied. Their sole oxygen source was a cylinder containing 250 standard litres of usable oxygen at dispatch and at activation. Each station had its own outlet; there were no leaks, other consumers, replacement cylinders or replenishment connections.
s2: Cabin oxygen installation | Maximum usable oxygen inventory at dispatch: 250 standard litres.
s3: Orvessa emergency oxygen specification: Following cabin depressurization, each occupied passenger station shall receive a continuous flow of 2 standard litres per minute for 15 minutes.

s1: Remote voting for shareholders at this year's AGM will run on PollDesk, as the board decided at its March meeting.
s2: PollDesk, the online ballot platform in use since the 2024 AGM, stores all shareholder data on servers in the United States.
s3: Tools that keep shareholder data outside the EU should not be used for AGM processes, registration and remote voting included.

s1: Marten type header, src/types.h, lines 2 to 4: rid_t and rlen_t are uint32_t, 4 bytes each, and kind_t is uint16_t, 2 bytes, so the fields need 10 bytes. The compiler aligns this struct to 4 bytes and adds 2 bytes of tail padding, which gives 12, and it never makes a struct smaller than its fields. The build allows no packing pragma.
s2: Marten Log Store, src/rec.h, line 12, compile-time check: A static assertion requires the record header to occupy exactly twelve bytes, and every release build made with the one supported compiler at default settings passes it.
s3: Only one definition of the record header exists in the log store, and it lists three members in this order, an id of type rid_t, a length of type rlen_t and a kind of type kind_t.

s1: Two kinds of student research project record health details: MSc nutrition dissertations and sports science pilot trials.
s2: ETH-2: The full ethics committee shall be able to review any research that records health details.
s3: Every student research project shall be reviewed by the departmental panel only, and never by the full ethics committee.

s2: The board of directors must approve the annual budget before the CEO may authorize any executive compensation package.

s1: Kelmarsh Post, 'Listed buildings: the new rules', 16 January, para. 1: No original window in a listed building in Kelmarsh may be removed or replaced, the borough conservation office said. A window fitted after 1950 does not count as original under the rules.
s2: By 1 September, each window of a let flat in Kelmarsh shall be fitted with fire-rated glass, the borough fire safety code says.
s3: Housing office file note, Kelmarsh, 20 January: Corbel Yard, a listed former mill, holds six let flats. Every window in the flats is a plastic unit fitted in 1987, when the mill was converted, and none has fire-rated glass. The landlord has booked new units for July. s2: Hallorn Valley control centre log, 3 February: Service 2B19 crossed the Hallorn Gorge bridge at 08:42, and the duty controller handled the move correctly under the bridge wind instruction.
s3: Bridge monitoring register, Hallorn Gorge, 3 February, row 8: | wind at 08:42: 85 km/h | shields raised: 07:50 | locked on every panel: 07:50 to 11:00 | Data accurate. The instruction was in force and allows no crossing with shields half raised.

s1: [CH-12] A newly acquired substance shall be entered in the site inventory only once its RA has been signed off.
s2: [CH-13] Each risk assessment (RA) shall be prepared from the exposure scenario in the supplier's extended SDS, as described in Annex D.
s3: [CH-14] The extended safety data sheet (SDS) for a new chemical is obtained only through the inventory system, which requests it from the supplier once the chemical is entered in the inventory.

s1: Betty Haldane was a patient in the Heron unit at Corran Cottage Hospital for three nights in October 2018, after a fall in the garden.
s2: Reader's letter to the Corran Evening Post, sent by Tom Haldane: In forty years of marriage my wife and I have never once spent a night apart. We have slept under the same roof, in the same room, every single night since our wedding day in 1984.
s3: Corran Cottage Hospital, unit manager's file note, Heron unit: The unit has four single rooms, and each has a fold-out bed so that a partner may stay overnight. Tom Haldane slept on the fold-out bed in his wife's room all three nights, as the night staff log shows. The note is accurate and stands. Neither the note nor the letter records any night the couple spent in different rooms.

s1: Thornfield General Hospital, Clinical Alarm Management Policy ALM-3: Every red alarm raised by a bedside monitor shall be sent within 10 seconds to the phone of the nurse assigned to that patient. Showing the alarm on a central station or at the bedside does not satisfy this rule.
s2: Thornfield ward 7 alarm review, 14 November: At 02:15 the bedside monitor of Gregor Feld, in bed 7-12, raised a red alarm for low oxygen saturation. His assigned nurse that night, Staff Nurse Amira Holt, worked only on ward 7 and carried a ward 7 phone, the only phone she had. An alarm cannot be reclassified after it is raised. ALM-3 and the ward 7 rule are both in force. Neither provides for a manual call, a pager, a runner sent from the central station in place of the phone message or a waiver.
s3: Between 23:00 and 06:00, no monitor alarm shall be sent to any phone on ward 7; in that period, alarms are shown only on the ward 7 central station.

s1: Front-of-house volunteers shall receive a level B gallery pass on their first shift, which opens the gallery doors but not the exhibit cabinets.
s2: Unpaid helpers, including front-of-house volunteers, may not open the exhibit cabinets at any time.
s3: AC-3: The indentured electrical trainee on the night shift will be given a permit for the live switchroom on Level B2 so they can assist with testing.

s1: A saver can sign the discharge form only once they have received the cash equivalent quote.
s2: The transfers team carries out ID verification for a transfer request only after the saver has signed and returned the discharge form, so it spends time only on savers who have firmly decided to leave the scheme.
s3: Every saver who asks to transfer out shall receive a cash equivalent quote, and the transfers team issues it only after the saver's ID verification is complete.

s1: Livestock Disease Control Ordinance (Pellhaven), s 17: Where an animal on any holding tests positive for vesicular hoof fever, the district veterinary officer shall cause every cloven-hoofed animal on that holding to be slaughtered within 48 hours after the result is notified.
s2: District veterinary office file, Orrowmere: On 9 October a ewe at Stannick Farm, a single holding, tested positive for vesicular hoof fever and the result was notified that day. The farm's 22 Greywether cattle are alive on the holding, are cloven-hoofed, and have each been entered in the Register of Protected Heritage Breeds since 2019. Both the Ordinance and the Heritage Breeds Protection Act are in force in Orrowmere. Neither provides for an exemption, a licence, a waiver, removal from the Register, vaccination or isolation in place of slaughter, or an extension of time, and slaughter means killing.
s3: No person shall at any time kill, or cause to be killed, an animal entered in the Register of Protected Heritage Breeds.

s1: Dunstrey Reasoning Paper, Question 30, premise 1: If the gate was locked that evening, the porter was on site that evening. There is one gate on the site, and only the porter, who carries the single key, can lock it.
s2: Setter's note, Dunstrey paper, Question 30: The gate was locked that evening, and the visitors' book does not carry the porter's initials for that evening. The porter came in through the service door at 17.40, as the caretaker's diary records. There is one porter and one visitors' book on the site. Neither the question nor the note provides for a second porter or a page missing from the book.
s3: If the porter was on site that evening, the visitors' book carries his initials for that evening, unless he came in through the service door, which has no book.

s1: Lotte Brask scored the winning goal for Ashgrove Hockey in Sunday's derby, a short-corner strike in the last minute, after missing Monday's session with a sore ankle.
s2: Captain Mirja Stolt, Ashgrove Hockey chat, pinned 4 January: anyone who plays on Sunday must have trained at least once that week, Monday or Wednesday. it's checked against the register every time, no exceptions.

s1: Orthopaedic ward file note, Fallowby, Mrs Hedda Crane, 20 September: Mrs Crane, 73, had a right hip replacement that ended at 11:00 today. She had heparin-induced thrombocytopenia in 2021, confirmed by antibody testing. Fondaparinux 2.5 mg was given at 17:00 and is charted daily for 28 days. Fondaparinux is not a heparin. Both documents are in force at Fallowby. Neither provides for a waiver, stockings alone or a later first dose.
s2: Fallowby Hospital, VTE Prophylaxis Guideline VP-02 v6, rec. 1.3: Every adult who has a hip or knee replacement shall receive drug prophylaxis against VTE starting 6 hours after surgery and lasting 28 days. Dalteparin is the drug used, except in an adult with past heparin-induced thrombocytopenia, who shall instead receive fondaparinux 2.5 mg daily.
s3: No heparin of any kind, unfractionated or low molecular weight, shall be given to an adult who has had heparin-induced thrombocytopenia.

s1: No treatment for a sports injury shall be covered for any member on the Basic plan.
s2: Health Insurance Policy of Tarnwell Health, Benefit 4: Physiotherapy prescribed by a GP shall be covered for up to 10 sessions in each policy year.
s3: Tarnwell Health claims file TH-6602: Mr Jonas Adle is a member on the Basic plan. His GP prescribed him 6 physiotherapy sessions for a knee injury he suffered playing football, which is a sports injury, and these are his first sessions this policy year. Physiotherapy is treatment. s1: No aspirin shall be given at any dose to a person with aspirin-sensitive asthma.
s2: Antenatal booking file note, Ashwyke, Mrs Sunniva Rand, 3 February: Mrs Rand, 36, is 12 weeks pregnant and at high risk of pre-eclampsia because of chronic hypertension. She had a severe asthma attack after aspirin in 2018, and aspirin-sensitive asthma was confirmed by challenge test. Fortnightly blood pressure and urine checks are booked from today. Both documents are in force at Ashwyke. Neither provides for a waiver, a lower aspirin dose or a desensitisation course.
s3: Ashwyke Maternity Unit, Hypertension in Pregnancy Guideline HP-02 v5, rec. 1.4: Every pregnant woman at high risk of pre-eclampsia shall take aspirin 150 mg nightly from 12 weeks until birth, except a woman with aspirin-sensitive asthma, who shall instead have blood pressure and urine checks every two weeks from 12 weeks.

s1: Encounter P614 has a verified scale reading of 68.21 kg. Its outbound dosing message contains weight_kg=68.2. This interface is the dosing engine’s sole source of patient weight; the engine has no prior weight, scale connection or manual-entry route and uses the received value directly.

s1: Data collection procedures shall start only after the research participant's informed consent has been obtained.
s2: Every research participant shall give written informed consent, free of coercion or undue influence, before any data collection begins.
s3: Researchers may approach participants for informed consent only after the ethics committee has granted final study approval.

s1: Probationary employees are excluded from the annual performance appraisal cycle because their employment status is not yet confirmed, and no performance review obligations apply to them during the probationary period.
s2: Personnel in a probationary employment period are ineligible for any performance-based incentive bonus program until that period has formally concluded.

s1: Pharmacy CCTV Code of Practice, CCTV-5: Recordings from the camera over the controlled drugs cupboard shall be retained for at least 90 days. Losing or overwriting any footage sooner breaches this code, and no pharmacist may cut the period short.
s2: Security office memo, Marrowby Infirmary pharmacy, recorder VR-2, 18 August: The recorder overwrites footage only once it is 100 days old; the disk holds 104 days at the fixed frame rate, and the overwrite age cannot be set lower by staff. The camera records around the clock. The code and the storage rule both apply. Neither allows an export or a second recorder.

s1: A system administrator with Tier-2 privileges may adjust the session timeout threshold only after the Security Review Board (SRB) approves the proposed change via a signed change request submitted at least 48 hours in advance.
s2: The security architecture baseline document, which sets the threat model and control objectives for the system, should be reviewed and approved before the static code analysis toolchain configuration is finalized and the analysis report generated.
s3: Integration testing, including all inter-module communication validation and regression suites, shall reach signed-off completion before the security architecture baseline document may be issued.

s1: Kit Partnership between Halwell Rovers RFC and Tollan Brewing BV, sch. A, para 2: For every senior fixture of 2026/27, Halwell's players are to take the field with Tollan's ZERO-T mark printed across the back of the jersey. Plain jerseys are not an option.
s2: Halwell commercial desk, kit memo of 2 July: ZERO-T is a beer of 0.05% ABV, and its logo appears on no other Tollan product. The club plays 22 league matches in 2026/27, all in senior match jerseys, and the partner cannot be changed during the season. The union regulation binds the club, and the partnership offers no alternative jersey design.
s3: No match jersey shall bear the logo of an alcoholic drink, and a logo used only for a drink of 0.5% ABV or less is not such a logo.

s1: The roofing team will have the Block B goods hoist from 07:00 until 10:00 on Mondays.
s2: The Block B goods hoist, hired instead of a second crane because the access road cannot take outriggers, can serve one trade at a time and no more.

s1: Before granting approval, the security compliance team shall verify that any IaC template submitted for production deployment includes encrypted storage configurations, network segmentation rules and role-based access control policies.
s2: The production Kubernetes cluster secrets carry a namespace policy that requires all accessors to hold an active internal service mesh identity certificate.
s3: The DevOps team has delegated read access to the production Kubernetes cluster secrets to the external security consultants for the upcoming compliance audit.

s1: Staffing note, Greenvale High School exams office, 2 May: Ms Adeyemi is the school's only qualified chemistry teacher, and no outside teacher may be brought in. Her son Tunde is entered for the Chemistry practical on 14 May, and his entry cannot be withdrawn. The practical has a single sitting, with all candidates in one lab at once, and the school admits no separate sitting or remote supervisor.
s2: Greenvale High School, Practical Exam Rules, rule C-1: The Chemistry practical exam shall be supervised for its whole length by a qualified chemistry teacher, present in the lab at every moment. A lab technician, a cover supervisor or a teacher of another subject does not count, however experienced.
s3: No teacher shall supervise any part of an exam that is taken by their own child.

s1: AR-12: Every summative exam in the faculty shall be invigilated by at least two staff members, as set out on page 7 of the Assessment Regulations.
s2: Online open-book tests in the faculty, the weekly quizzes and the final module test among them, are taken at home and are never invigilated by staff.
s3: Under the faculty assessment regulations, the online open-book final test that closes each module counts as a summative exam and decides the module grade.

s1: Ellery Coast FM is bound by its licence to keep its airwaves silent from 11:00 to 11:02 every Armistice Day, with no speech, music or tone of any kind.
s2: Station log, Ellery Coast FM, Armistice Day: | 10:58:30 storm warning received from the coastguard, Ellery headland | 10:58:50 warning read on air by presenter Una Rhys | 11:00:00 to 11:02:00 silence held | 11:02:05 warning repeated | No other warning arrived that morning. Both the licence and the act are in force. Neither provides for a shorter silence, and none was needed.
s3: Ellery Coast Herald, 'Storm warnings go out on air', 4 October, p. 3: Any storm warning passed to a local station must be on air within one minute of its arrival, under the coast safety act, the coastguard said.

s1: Commissioning of the UFH manifold shall not start until the floor screed has cured for 21 days, because early heat cracks the screed.
s2: The UFH manifold will be commissioned before the pipes get their pressure test, so that each circuit is filled and vented through its own valve.
s3: The underfloor heating (UFH) pipes shall be pressure tested at 6 bar for at least 2 hours before the floor screed is laid.

s1: TS-3.1: A fabric lot can be released to the cutting room only once the testing lab has signed off its colourfastness report (Section 6.2).
s2: TS-4.2: Each pre-production sample (PPS) shall be sewn and approved only after its fabric lot has been released to the cutting room.
s3: TS-3.4: The testing lab will sign off a fabric lot's colourfastness report only after the matching pre-production sample (PPS) has been approved (see clause 6.5).

s1: Only container images whose critical findings the security team has fixed or accepted may enter staging.
s2: For backups of resources outside EU-Sovereign, 'encrypted' means AES-256 with keys held in the shared key management service (KMS).
s3: EU-Sovereign resources must never use the shared key management service (KMS).

s1: The Independent System Operator may generate and submit a Load Flow Compliance Report for a transmission segment only after the interconnection facility serving that segment is fully commissioned and operating data has been collected under live grid conditions.
s2: The demand response curtailment protocol for Class III industrial loads runs only when the serving generation asset is in islanded microgrid mode, so frequency stability holds independently of the transmission network.
s3: Under grid interconnection standards, a distributed generation facility in islanded microgrid mode and one in grid-synchronized mode cannot share the same point of common coupling at the same time, since their protection relay settings cannot work together.

s1: Virtual machines (VMs) in the production VPC will be patched and rebooted automatically each Sunday night by the patch service.
s2: Database (DB) primaries should not be restarted automatically, since the DBA team plans their restarts and failovers by hand.
s3: The DB primaries run as VMs inside the production VPC, the private network segment of the cloud account with its own address range and routes.

s1: No driver under a fatigue restriction may ride in any cab or on any footplate until that restriction ends.
s2: The two train drivers now under a fatigue restriction at Hollin depot shall be able to complete a route knowledge refresher (RKR) before that restriction is lifted.
s3: Every route knowledge refresher (RKR) shall include a journey in the front cab over the line being refreshed.

s1: The mare shall be turned out only in Paddock 3 at Coldmere Equestrian Centre and in no other field. The Owner chose Paddock 3 for its fencing and will not accept another. The Yard may not hire grazing elsewhere.
s2: Full Livery Agreement, Ms Harriet Doyle (Owner) and Coldmere Equestrian Centre (Yard), cl. 4.1: The Yard shall turn the Owner's mare, Bramble, out to grass for at least 4 hours on every day of the term. Time on a horse walker or in a sand school does not count as turnout.

s2: Tallyfold, the target's document tool, stores all uploaded information on servers outside the EEA.

s1: Every person who executes a Chemical Safety Report under delegated authority must follow the Chemical Safety Assessment Procedures Manual kept by the Health, Safety and Environment function.
s2: The Chief Chemical Safety Officer may authorize Senior Safety Assessors to execute and countersign Chemical Safety Reports under REACH Article 14 when the officer is unavailable for more than five business days.
s3: Chemical Y's REACH Title II registration dossier may be submitted to ECHA only after the registrant completes the chemical safety assessment (CSA) and produces an exposure scenario covering all identified uses.

s1: Tamsworth Natural History Museum, Gallery Design Rules GD-4: All label text in the Little Explorers gallery shall be set at 24 pt or larger. No line of any label may be smaller, including credit lines and footnotes, and the rule applies to loaned objects as well as the museum's own.
s2: Tamsworth exhibitions file note, 2 April: The ichthyosaur fossil is displayed in the Little Explorers gallery, in a fixed case. s2: A procurement officer shall not issue a purchase order for critical components until the supplier is approved through the vendor qualification process.
s3: The warehouse receiving dock is scheduled and allocated for incoming goods only after a purchase order is fully executed and acknowledged.
